items.title: Kosuke Kawamura Turns Legendary ‘COBRA’ Manga Into a ¥3.5 Million JPY Contemporary Artwork
items.text: Kosuke Kawamura Turns Legendary ‘COBRA’ Manga Into a ¥3.5 Million JPY Contemporary Artwork Toei and TANGLE have officially launched the ReVIBES Project, a new collaborative initiative that reimagines some of Japan's most iconic IPs through contemporary art. Moving beyond nostalgia and conventional collaborations, the project transforms beloved classics into collectible artworks, introducing them to a new generation of collectors and the global art marketFor its inaugural edition, the project tapped internationally renowned collage artist, graphic designer, and art director Kosuke Kawamura to deconstruct and reassemble COBRA — Buichi Terasawa’s legendary sci-fi manga classic. The resulting two physical art pieces made their high-profile auction debut in Tokyo, fetching a combined ¥3.5 million JPY (approx. $24,000 USD). As Hiroto Munakata, representative of TANGLE and the mastermind behind the project's concept, explains: “This is not about reviving IP, but about reconstructing its value. We are not selling nostalgia — we want to show how masterpieces can be updated for the present day.”Why COBRA?First serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump in 1978, COBRA follows a rogue space pirate armed with a psychological, arm-embedded "Psycho-Gun". Infusing a singular universe with hard-boiled storytelling, cosmic action, and sharp humor, the manga immediately became a cornerstone of Japanese pop culture and has since been translated into over a dozen languages.Crucially, creator Buichi Terasawa was a legendary innovator who pioneered the integration of computer graphics into comic production, famously coining the term “digital manga”. Reinterpreting this exact spirit of technical disruption through a modern artistic lens forms the perfect foundation for ReVIBES Project.For Toei, the initiative represents a vital method for archival management. “No matter how great a work may be, the passage of time can gradually reduce it to something known only by a dedicated few,” notes Rintaro Shimatani of Toei. “Through ReVIBES Project, we believe these works can reach audiences they never had the opportunity to connect with before.”Kosuke Kawamura’s DeconstructionKnown for his cross-disciplinary portfolio spanning fashion, street culture, music and advertising, Kosuke Kawamura was uniquely suited to bridge the gap between subculture and high art. items.title: NikeSKIMS Wraps the Split-Toe Air Rift in Satin for Its "Obsidian" and "Night Silver" Pair
items.text: NikeSKIMS Wraps the Split-Toe Air Rift in Satin for Its "Obsidian" and "Night Silver" Pair Name: NikeSKIMS Air Rift SatinColorway: Obsidian, Night Silver/Base Grey-Medium SilverSKU: IQ7158-002, IQ7158-400MSRP: $160 USDRelease Date: July 30Where to Buy: Nike, SKIMSThe NikeSKIMS Rift Satin gives one of Nike's most divisive silhouettes a new lease on life, dressing the split-toe Air Rift in satin-like panels across a pair of colorways for the Studio Edit 02 collection. Offered in "Obsidian" and "Night Silver," the release keeps the model's unmistakable low-profile shape while refining its surface into something sleeker and more polished for Kim Kardashian’s SKIMS.For this iteration, the changes are focused on material and finish rather than structure. Satin-like panels give the Rift a cleaner, more elevated look without altering the low-profile shape that defines the model. The split-toe forefoot remains the centerpiece, while an adjustable strap runs across the midfoot to lock in the fit, a functional nod to the original's cinching system. Underfoot, the segmented outsole carries over, preserving the flexible, articulated feel that made the first Rift move so closely with the foot.The SKIMS colorways lean in different directions. The "Obsidian" pair takes a darker, moodier route, while the "Night Silver" version runs a tonal arrangement of Night Silver, Base Grey, and Medium Silver, stacking closely related metallic shades into a near-monochrome finish that plays into the ongoing appetite for silver footwear. Both treatments let the satin paneling do the talking, keeping branding minimal and the focus squarely on the silhouette's distinctive geometry.The Air Rift has always been a shoe defined by its silhouette. Nike introduced the model in 1996, drawing on the split-toe construction of the Japanese tabi and the barefoot efficiency of Kenyan distance runners, and the result was a minimal, glove-like runner unlike anything else in the catalog. That divisive, fashion-forward shape has made it a recurring favorite in cycles where minimalism and Y2K styling return to the forefront, and its reappearance under the NikeSKIMS banner slots neatly into that pattern. items.title: Apple's New Upgrade Program Lets You Lease an iPhone, Mac, or iPad Starting at $17.99 USD Monthly
items.text: Apple's New Upgrade Program Lets You Lease an iPhone, Mac, or iPad Starting at $17.99 USD Monthly Summary Apple has officially introduced Apple Upgrade, a new US-based leasing program for iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch modelsDeveloped in partnership with Klarna, the service offers 12- and 24-month terms for iPhones and Watches alongside 24- and 36-month terms for Macs and iPadsThe program replaces the existing iPhone Upgrade Program and provides options to upgrade early, purchase the device or return it at the end of the lease Apple has launched "Apple Upgrade," a comprehensive hardware leasing program designed to provide a more accessible entry point for its latest ecosystem of devices. Rolling out across the brand's online and physical stores in the United States, the service arrives just weeks after the tech giant hiked prices on its MacBooks and iPads amid ongoing industry component shortages. Now, users can lease an iPhone 17e starting at $17.99 USD per month, an Apple Watch Series 11 or iPad Air for $11.99 USD per month and a MacBook Air for $24.99 USD per month.Developed in partnership with financial provider Klarna, the service requires a soft credit check for approval and operates much like a standard vehicle lease. Customers commit to 12- or 24-month terms for iPhones and Apple Watches, while Mac and iPad plans extend to 24 or 36 months. At the end of the selected term, users can trade their device in for a next-generation model, buy the hardware outright with a one-time payment or simply return the product and exit the ecosystem entirely. To lower monthly costs, participants can integrate their existing hardware through Apple Trade In or earn three percent Daily Cash back by paying with an Apple Card.The new initiative effectively phases out the decade-old iPhone Upgrade Program, which is no longer accepting new enrollments. A critical shift in the transition is the removal of bundled AppleCare coverage, a feature previously baked into the legacy mobile leasing plan. Furthermore, the brand appears to be establishing strict guardrails to ensure consistent payments. Code discovered in early beta builds of iOS 27 suggests developers are preparing a restricted mode capable of locking financed devices out of specific applications if accounts fall into arrears. items.title: Starbucks Japan Turns Its Menu Into Blind Box Collectible Plush Charms With the "Joyful Capsule" Series
items.text: Starbucks Japan Turns Its Menu Into Blind Box Collectible Plush Charms With the "Joyful Capsule" Series Starbucks Japan is stepping into capsule-toy territory for the first time with the Starbucks Joyful Capsule, a run of palm-sized plush charms shaped like the chain's most recognizable menu items. Sold through blind capsules under the concept "Starbucks Charm with Warmth," the collectibles arrive August 2, a date the company marks as the anniversary of its arrival in Japan.The concept plugs directly into one of Japan's most entrenched retail rituals. Gachapon, the capsule-toy vending machines that dispense a random collectible for a set price, have been a fixture of Japanese consumer culture for decades, and the blind-box format they pioneered has since become a global engine for hype-driven collecting, from designer vinyl figures to the plush-charm boom that brands now chase. By issuing its first capsule toy through this system, Starbucks is borrowing a mechanic built for repeat pulls and trade-driven community, the same surprise-and-collect logic that has powered so many recent drop phenomena.The products themselves lean on that collectible instinct. The standard lineup comprises five designs, each a plush rendering of a Starbucks staple: a Double Tall Latte in a To Go cup, a Caramel Macchiato in a For Here glass, a TOKYO Roast, a Matcha Cream Frappuccino, and a Sugar Donut. Every capsule contains one charm at random, so buyers only learn which they have pulled once the roughly 75mm shell cracks open. Each charm carries a hook, a small but deliberate design choice that lets collectors chain favorites together or clip them onto bags and pouches, extending the appeal from a single pull into a modular, mix-and-match set.Timing gives the drop added resonance. Starbucks entered the Japanese market three decades ago, and the brand has grown into one of the country's most culturally embedded foreign imports, its seasonal Frappuccinos and regional exclusives treated with the kind of anticipation usually reserved for streetwear. Anchoring the launch to its landing anniversary frames the charms as a celebration of that history rather than a simple merchandise play.A more exclusive tier extends the collection at Starbucks Reserve Roastery Tokyo, which receives its own Starbucks Reserve Joyful Capsule the same day. items.title: Palm Angels Wants You To Explore the “Lost Frames” in Its FW26 Campaign
items.text: Palm Angels Wants You To Explore the “Lost Frames” in Its FW26 Campaign Summary Palm Angels unveils its FW26 "Lost Frames" campaign, lensed in a historic theatre using a grainy VHS aesthetic.The range updates signature tracksuits, technical outerwear, tailoring and fluid mini dresses with rich fabrications.The collection is now available via Palm Angels and select global retailers. Palm Angels’ Fall/Winter 2026 campaign, titled “Lost Frames,” unfolds as a cinematic exploration of memory and atmosphere. Shot by Sharna Osbourne and Van Khokhlov inside a historic theatre, the visuals, defined by Osbourne’s VHS aesthetic, capture empty auditoriums, backstage corners and softly lit interiors, creating a tactile, timeworn quality that blurs the line between performance and aftermath.The narrative unfolds across empty auditoriums, backstage corners, and velvet-draped balconies, creating an intimate, lingering post-show atmosphere. Within this low-lit setting, the collection shines through its rich material depth, using treated jersey, premium denim, and tactile fabrics designed to transition effortlessly from daytime wear to evening outings.The FW26 product range balances refined tailoring with Palm Angels’ core athletic identity. Women's silhouettes lean into confident femininity via fluid mini dresses, precise suiting, and elevated knitwear, while the men's offering reinterprets sportswear staples - such as signature tracksuits, technical outerwear, and oversized shirting - with richer fabrications and cleaner construction. items.title: Logitech Says It Has No Plans for a New Gaming Handheld to Follow the G Cloud
items.text: Logitech Says It Has No Plans for a New Gaming Handheld to Follow the G Cloud Summary Logitech G head Robin Piispanen confirmed the company has no immediate plans for a second-generation G Cloud handheldThe executive cited a lack of proprietary content as a significant disadvantage compared to industry leaders like Nintendo and ValveRoughly 80 percent of original buyers eventually stopped using the streaming device to pivot toward other projects Logitech G global head of gaming Robin Piispanen revealed that the company is currently focused on different priorities than a follow-up to its 2022 streaming handheld. Speaking to The Verge, the executive explained that successful portable platforms typically require deep integration with proprietary games. This specific strategy propelled the success of the Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch. Without a dedicated storefront or exclusive titles, the brand faces a massive hurdle in competing against established hardware giants.The original G Cloud found a dedicated niche of users at launch. Piispanen admitted that the product failed to sustain long-term engagement for the vast majority of buyers. He noted that approximately 80 percent of consumers bought the device, tested it and ultimately placed it in a drawer. Slow development of cloud gaming infrastructure played a major role in this decline. Major providers did not build out the necessary architecture quickly enough to support a seamless portable streaming experience. Microsoft even acknowledged that running cloud operations remains highly expensive.Current market conditions make returning to the portable sector even more difficult for independent hardware manufacturers. Competitors operate on extremely slim margins while relying on partnerships to maintain relevance. Component prices are currently surging across the tech industry. High-powered alternatives like the Ayaneo Next 2 command premium price tags, while select Steam Deck models recently saw significant price increases. Constructing a standalone device would require Logitech to navigate these steep supply chain costs without software sales to subsidize the hardware.Despite the initial setback, the tech company is not abandoning portable gaming concepts entirely. Executives are holding ongoing discussions with industry heavyweights like Microsoft and Tencent to explore how the ecosystem might evolve. items.title: A Brand New Survival-Horror Title Is Coming to the SEGA Dreamcast 25 Years After SEGA Left the Console Market
items.text: A Brand New Survival-Horror Title Is Coming to the SEGA Dreamcast 25 Years After SEGA Left the Console Market Summary Independent developers continue to release original titles for the Sega Dreamcast more than 25 years after the console was officially discontinued in 2001The latest project is White Creek, a survival-horror game that utilizes the system's 3D capabilities to deliver a cinematic experience comparable to the NAOMI arcade eraThe console's enduring homebrew scene is supported by its lack of modern digital rights management and hardware that allows booting from standard CDs Twenty-five years after Sega exited the console market, the SEGA Dreamcast remains a viable platform for new software development. The recently announced White Creek, developed by Story Bird Studios and published by PixelHeart, arrives as a dedicated survival-horror title built specifically for the vintage hardware. Instead of merely drawing inspiration from late-1990s classics, the development team engineered the project to maximize the technical limits of the Dreamcast. Players experience 3D environments and fixed cinematic camera angles that rival high-end arcade productions of the NAOMI era. The title is also planned for a simultaneous release on Steam.Set in an isolated and cursed wintry town, the narrative follows exorcist protagonist Alicia Morelli. She investigates a localized outbreak of violence and encounters possessed residents haunted by lost souls. Gameplay balances action and psychological tension by forcing players to make critical moral choices. Alicia can execute threats with firearms or use her psychic powers to exorcise and save them. Her arsenal includes a mobile phone used to detect spiritual anomalies and solve environmental puzzles. Confronting corrupted souls in intense Exorcism Overdrive sequences requires gathering evidence and breaking through visual illusions to bring peace to the town.The sheer longevity of the Dreamcast is rooted in its highly accessible architecture. Hackers easily bypassed the proprietary GD-ROM format years ago, allowing users to boot homebrew software directly from standard CDs without requiring internal hardware modifications. Unlike modern platforms that rely on mandatory network authentication, the final Sega console lacks remote kill switches. items.title: Macaulay Culkin's ‘Home Alone’ Return Reportedly Gains Momentum as Disney Courts the Star
items.text: Macaulay Culkin's ‘Home Alone’ Return Reportedly Gains Momentum as Disney Courts the Star Macaulay Culkin's long-rumored return to Home Alone may be inching closer, with a new report suggesting Disney is eager to bring the star back for a proper legacy sequel. The claim comes from Matt Belloni of The Town podcast, who reported that Culkin was recently seen on the Disney lot and that the studio is keen to court him, though no deal has been formally announced.Per Belloni's report, Disney is said to be enthusiastic about making a Culkin-led sequel happen, with the studio reportedly viewing his pitch as a strong idea and eager to secure his involvement. Those characterizations come entirely from the podcast, and it is worth stressing that nothing has been confirmed by either the actor or the studio, leaving the project firmly in the rumor stage for now. Still, the report frames the momentum as more concrete than in previous years, positioning a return as a real possibility rather than idle speculation.The pitch itself is not new. During his 2025 "A Nostalgic Night With Macaulay Culkin" tour, the actor laid out his vision for a third chapter in which a now-adult Kevin McCallister has become a neglectful father and finds himself locked out of his home by his young son. The premise would flip the original's formula, casting Kevin in the intruder role once held by the Wet Bandits as he attempts to break back into the house, and metaphorically back into his child's life, while dodging the traps his son has set. That inversion would leave little narrative room for the return of Joe Pesci and Daniel Stern's burglars.Culkin's history with the series adds weight to the report's appeal. The actor headlined 1990's Home Alone and its 1992 follow-up Home Alone 2: Lost in New York, then stepped away from the franchise entirely. The property carried on without him across several installments, beginning with 1997's Home Alone 3 and continuing through 2002's Home Alone 4, 2012's Home Alone: The Holiday Heist, and the 2021 reboot Home Sweet Home Alone, none of which recaptured the original's cultural pull. A Culkin-led entry would mark his first involvement in more than three decades.Any reunion would arrive under bittersweet circumstances, however. Chris Columbus, who directed the first two films, has voiced skepticism about revisiting the material, telling Entertainment Tonight in 2025 that he believes the original moment cannot be recaptured. items.title: ChatGPT Now Refuses to Mimic Famous Authors' Writing Styles Over Copyright Concerns
items.text: ChatGPT Now Refuses to Mimic Famous Authors' Writing Styles Over Copyright Concerns Summary ChatGPT is now blocking user requests to generate text in the specific writing styles of famous authorsThe AI refuses direct imitation but offers to create original content capturing the broader aesthetic qualities of a requested writerOpenAI quietly rolled out the guardrail amid a wave of high-profile legal challenges from major authors and publishers OpenAI quietly rolled out a massive new guardrail for its flagship product. Users attempting to generate text mimicking the specific style of famous authors are now hitting a digital brick wall. ChatGPT is explicitly declining direct prompts to clone the literary voices of prominent writers. The system points to copyright protections for both living and deceased creators when blocking these requests.Testing conducted by Ars Technica and the research publication No Latency first highlighted the behavioral shift. When prompted to channel Agatha Christie for a mystery story, the chatbot refuses the direct imitation. It offers a compromise instead. The system volunteers to produce original content possessing the general hallmarks associated with the requested writer. A prompt asking for Stephen King yields an offer to generate atmospheric horror and small-town dread without copying his exact distinctive voice. This restriction applies to a wide spectrum of literary icons ranging from Charles Dickens to contemporary figures like J.K. Rowling and Amy Tan.The structural update follows a massive wave of copyright infringement lawsuits. Organizations such as the Authors Guild and major media entities including The New York Times allege the tech giant trained its artificial intelligence models on copyrighted materials without permission. Copyright law traditionally protects the specific expression of an idea rather than a general aesthetic. An AI-generated stylistic imitation could cross into infringement territory if the output becomes substantially similar to the original creator's work. By stopping the chatbot from directly cloning a writer's identity, the company appears to be building a defensive legal narrative. The move frames its generative tools as engines for inspiration rather than mechanisms for wholesale reproduction.Creative communities are already feeling the friction from the unannounced restriction. items.title: WILD LIFE TAILOR and Wrangler Rework a Workwear Staple Into a Suede Double-Knee Jean
items.text: WILD LIFE TAILOR and Wrangler Rework a Workwear Staple Into a Suede Double-Knee Jean Summary The Wrangler for WILD LIFE TAILOR EX Suede Double Knee Jean pairs a relaxed straight silhouette with a workwear-rooted double-knee constructionWashable cow suede reinforces the knee panels, balancing a premium hand-feel with everyday practicalityThe special order was designed from a newly created pattern made exclusively for WILD LIFE TAILOR Wrangler and WILD LIFE TAILOR have joined forces on the EX Suede Double Knee Jean, a special order that filters the denim label's utilitarian roots through a considered, retailer-exclusive lens. Rather than pull an existing fit off the shelf, the two built the jean from a newly drafted pattern, threading a workwear signature through a silhouette designed specifically for this release.Wrangler's identity has always been tied to labor and the American West, a brand that made its name outfitting rodeo riders and working cowboys with denim engineered to survive the saddle and the job site. The double-knee construction at the center of this collaboration draws on that same lineage, a reinforcement detail long associated with carpenters, ranch hands, and tradespeople who needed their trousers to outlast the wear that knees take first. By anchoring the project to a feature the source itself frames as emblematic of workwear, Wrangler and WILD LIFE TAILOR position the piece as a nod to function before fashion.Where the special order departs from tradition is in its material choices. The knee panels are executed in washable cow suede, an upgrade that lends the utilitarian detail a more refined texture while sidestepping the fragility suede usually carries, since it can be laundered rather than babied. The base is a straight-leg jean cut with a moderate amount of room, a relaxed shape that reads closer to a contemporary tailored fit than the rigid, body-hugging cuts of Wrangler's mid-century catalog. Offered in black and indigo, the two colorways keep the palette grounded and versatile, letting the suede reinforcement carry the visual interest.The collaboration also reflects WILD LIFE TAILOR's position within the JUN retail group, whose customer center handles inquiries for the release, and points to the growing appetite among Japanese specialty retailers for reworking heritage American workwear through a local, detail-driven sensibility. items.title: Jessica Ogden and A.P.C. Reconstruct Brighton's Victorian Tilework for Their 30th “QUILTS” Chapter
items.text: Jessica Ogden and A.P.C. Reconstruct Brighton's Victorian Tilework for Their 30th “QUILTS” Chapter Summary The 30th A.P.C. QUILTS collection draws its patterns from the tiled entrance steps of Victorian houses in BrightonDesigns were built by photographing the tilework from multiple angles, printing the images, then cutting and reassembling them as collageThe release continues the ongoing quilt partnership between A.P.C. and British designer Jessica Ogden A.P.C. and Jessica Ogden are back with the 30th edition of A.P.C. QUILTS, the pair's long-running textile series, and this chapter finds its starting point on the English coast. The collection grew out of walks along the Brighton seaside, where the tiled doorstep steps of Victorian-era homes, each carrying its own distinct pattern, became the unlikely source material for a new run of quilts.The QUILTS project has been one of the quieter but more enduring threads in A.P.C.'s catalog, a recurring collaboration with Jessica Ogden that reframes the quilt as a canvas for craft and reuse rather than a seasonal throw. Ogden, a British designer with deep roots in patchwork and hand-driven construction, has long treated the medium as a way to salvage and recombine, and her sensibility has given the series a consistency that survives across its many installments. Founded by Jean Touitou, A.P.C. has always positioned itself around a certain restraint and material honesty, which makes Ogden's tactile, improvisational approach a natural counterpoint within the house.For this installment, that recombinant instinct turns toward architecture. Ogden and A.P.C. looked to the mosaic tilework set into the entrance stairs of Brighton's Victorian houses, a detail most passersby overlook, and treated the individuality of each home's pattern as a design library. The process was deliberately mediated rather than literal: the tiles were photographed from various angles, those images printed, and the printed patterns then cut apart and reconstructed into collage. The finished quilts read as an abstraction of an abstraction, translating hand-laid Victorian geometry through the lens of the camera and the scissors.That method sits comfortably within the series' established logic, where found visual information gets fragmented and rebuilt into something new. items.text: Apple TV Drops the ‘Ted Lasso’ Season Four Trailer, Sending Ted to Coach a Women's Team Summary Apple TV has released the trailer for the fourth season of the global hit 'Ted Lasso,' led by Jason SudeikisSeason four sends Ted back to Richmond to take on a second-division women's football teamThe ten-episode season premieres August 5 and runs weekly through October 7 Ted Lasso is officially returning for a fourth season, with Apple TV releasing a first look that finds the relentlessly optimistic coach facing an entirely new challenge. This time out, Ted (Jason Sudeikis) heads back to Richmond to coach a second-division women's football team, a premise that reframes the show's familiar underdog formula around a fresh roster and a different corner of the sport.The new season leans into that leap-of-faith spirit as its central theme, with the trailer signaling that Ted and his players learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would. It marks a notable shift for a series that spent its first three seasons chronicling a men's Premier League side, moving Ted into the women's game while keeping him anchored to the club and the town that defined his story. The setup preserves the show's core appeal, its warmth and its faith in people, while giving the fourth season a clear reason to exist beyond nostalgia. That return carries weight because of how large Ted Lasso loomed at its peak. The show became one of Apple TV's signature titles after its 2020 debut, growing from a sleeper into an awards juggernaut and a genuine cultural touchstone built on kindness rather than cynicism. Its earlier seasons racked up a substantial haul of Emmy recognition, a pedigree the source underscores by pointing to the Emmy pedigree of stars Sudeikis and Hannah Waddingham and creatives like Brett Goldstein and Jack Burditt. A fourth season arrives, then, as both a continuation and a test of whether that lightning can strike again.The cast reunites a deep bench of fan favorites, with Waddingham, Juno Temple, Goldstein, Brendan Hunt, and Jeremy Swift all returning to Richmond. They are joined by a wave of new additions including Tanya Reynolds, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay, Rex Hayes, Aisling Sharkey, Abbie Hern, and Grant Feely. items.title: A Vow Written in Scent: Inside AVAU’s First Permanent Space in Milan
items.text: A Vow Written in Scent: Inside AVAU’s First Permanent Space in Milan Summary AVAU opens its first boutique in Milan's Brera district.Designed with Crosby Studios, the space merges historic details with stainless steel.Features include a Vatican fresco-inspired sofa and a central "Magic Tray". Italian fragrance house AVAU has officially opened its first permanent home at Via Fiori Chiari 7 in Milan's historic Brera district. Founded by siblings Leonardo, Carolina and Caterina Catalani - who bring three generations of family perfumery heritage to the venture - the brand's name serves as the phonetic expression of "A Vow." Rooted in the Catalani siblings’ family heritage, the boutique reflects AVAU’s guiding principle of “A Promise Made Scent,” offering visitors an immersive environment that encourages conversation, discovery and connection.In a notable creative collaboration, AVAU partnered with designer Harry Nuriev and his multidisciplinary practice Crosby Studios to bring the space to life. The interior design establishes a striking dialogue between heritage and contemporary craftsmanship, where original walls, exposed timber beams and a restored fireplace coexist with sleek stainless steel work surfaces and laboratory-inspired fixtures. Upon entering, visitors are greeted by a living room anchored by a bespoke sofa. Its upholstery is inspired by the frescoes of Vatican City, paying homage to the founders' grandparents, who once operated a perfumery inside the Vatican.Opposite the living room sits the "Magic Tray," a prominent display showcasing the house's collection of six fragrances. This design feature recreates a cherished family ritual from the founders' childhood, when their mother would ask each morning which fragrance they had chosen to wear for the day. The kitchen also serves as the symbolic heart of the Home, where ideas are exchanged and the brand’s creative vision continues to evolve.AVAU ParfumVia Fiori Chiari, 7, 20121 Milano MI, Italy View this post on Instagram A post shared by AVAU (@avauparfum) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Lalique Opens First Directly Operated Osaka Boutique at QUARTZ SHINSAIBASHI
items.text: Lalique Opens First Directly Operated Osaka Boutique at QUARTZ SHINSAIBASHI Summary Lalique opens its first directly operated Kansai boutique at QUARTZ SHINSAIBASHI.Spanning 106 square meters, the space features integrated crystal panels, suspended Champs-Elysées installations and iconic vases alongside Japan-inspired collections. Lalique has opened its first directly operated boutique in Osaka, located at QUARTZ Shinsaibashi, marking a significant milestone in the Maison’s expansion in Japan. The new space introduces Lalique’s full creative universe to the Kansai region for the first time, reflecting the brand’s commitment to immersive retail environments and closer client relationships. Set in the vibrant Shinsaibashi district, the boutique is conceived as more than a retail space, designed to showcase crystal through light, transparency, and texture.Spanning 106 square meters, the boutique features crystal panels with motifs such as Lauriers and Merles et Raisins, alongside a suspended Champs-Elysées liana installation. Iconic creations including Bacchantes, Mossi and Tourbillons are displayed alongside Pivoines, Plumes, and Lalique’s signature animal sculptures. Collections inspired by cherry blossoms, such as Fleurs de Cerisier and Sakura, echo Japanese cultural motifs and highlight René Lalique’s enduring dialogue with nature. The boutique also presents the full breadth of Lalique’s universe, from crystal vases and decorative objects to jewellery, fragrances, and architectural pieces like chandeliers and interior panels.The Osaka opening also marks the Japan debut of Lalique’s collaboration with Fromental, the renowned handcrafted wallpaper house. These designs enrich the boutique with a new layer of depth, establishing a dialogue between crystal and decorative arts.Lalique Shinsaibashi3F, Quartz Shinsaibashi, 3 Chome−12−14Minamisenba Chuo Ward, Osaka,〒542-0081, Japan Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: MING and Royal Selangor Tap Local Pewter Craft for the All-New 37.06 Watch
items.text: MING and Royal Selangor Tap Local Pewter Craft for the All-New 37.06 Watch Summary MING and Royal Selangor debut the 88-piece 37.06 Titanium Watch.It features a hand-hammered pewter dial made in Kuala Lumpur.Retailing for CHF 5,000, it marks MING's first locally assembled timepiece. MING has unveiled the 37.06 Royal Selangor, its newest limited-edition timepiece celebrating celebrating Malaysian craft through an unexpected material: pewter.Created in collaboration with Royal Selangor, the watch features a hand-hammered pewter dial housed in MING’s lightweight grade‑2 titanium case. The partnership brings together Royal Selangor’s 140‑year heritage in pewter craftsmanship with MING’s contemporary design language, resulting in a timepiece that is both culturally rooted and visually distinctive.The dial, produced in Kuala Lumpur, showcases pewter’s natural depth and texture, catching light differently from every angle to give each watch a unique character. Paired with the brushed titanium case, domed sapphire crystals, and Super‑LumiNova X1‑coated hands, the design balances warmth with modern precision. Inside, the Swiss‑made Sellita SW300.M1 automatic movement offers a 50‑hour power reserve, visible through the exhibition caseback. Notably, the entire run will be assembled locally in Kuala Lumpur, underscoring the collaboration’s authenticity and commitment to Malaysian craft.Retailing at 5,000 CHF (approx. $ 6,133 USD), the 37.06 Royal Selangor comes with a blue‑grey goat leather strap by Jean Rousseau and is delivered in a special hammered pewter presentation box crafted by Royal Selangor. Availability begins today at Royal Selangor boutiques, with a small number of pieces offered via MING's official website starting August 6, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Baseus Debuts the PicoGo Series: The Thinnest Power Duo Built for Digital Nomads For modern digital nomads constantly on the move, staying powered without being weighed down is essential. The Baseus PicoGo Series emerges as the ultimate everyday carry, presenting the thinnest power duo designed specifically to meet the demands of modern travel. By combining the ultra-slim 5,000mAh PicoGo Air with the robust 10,000mAh AM52, Baseus has created a complementary system that covers virtually every charging scenario on the road with minimal burden. Embracing the mantra to "charge your passion, power your journey," this series provides travelers with an ideal, lightweight solution that perfectly supports an unencumbered, nomadic lifestyle.Leading the lineup with a pioneering, minimalist fashion aesthetic is the Baseus PicoGo Air 5K. Measuring a razor-slim 6.9mm and weighing just 3.7 ounces—roughly half the weight of an iPhone 17 Pro—it provides exceptionally thin, light, and fast charging tailored for mobile phones. The power bank utilizes the same semi-solid-state cells found in the iPhone Air, ensuring high performance within a remarkably sleek footprint. Furthermore, it introduces seamless NFC battery visibility; with a single tap, users can access real-time cell health, temperature, and safety status directly through the Baseus app. Better yet, from July 1 through August 31, 2026, travelers can grab the PicoGo Air for just $39.99 USD (down 34% from its original $59.99 USD price tag) when using the promo code EHYGXRMR at checkout.Beyond its striking physical design, the PicoGo Air sets a new benchmark for portable power safety and thermal management. The device features thermal control from its core to its case, utilizing a combination of graphene, aerogel, and an iPhone-matched aluminum alloy housing to maximize heat dissipation. This hardware cooling is paired with a proprietary AI chip that monitors temperatures 18,000 times per hour for precise regulation. Conforming to one of the world's most stringent mandatory safety standards under China's Safety Technical Specification for Power Banks, the PicoGo Air has successfully passed both a 20kN crush test and a nail penetration test without catching fire.Perfectly complementing the Air is the Baseus PicoGo AM52 with built-in cable, which scales up the capacity to 10,000mAh while maintaining an ultra-slim 16mm profile that remains lighter than an iPhone 17 Pro. items.title: TAG Heuer, Team Ikuzawa and Bamford Reunite for a 150-Piece Carrera Chronograph
items.text: TAG Heuer, Team Ikuzawa and Bamford Reunite for a 150-Piece Carrera Chronograph Summary TAG Heuer, Team Ikuzawa \and Bamford release a collaborative Carrera Chronograph, limited to 150 pieces.The design draws inspiration from '70s- '80s Roadmaster stopwatches, but reinterpreted with modern features.Priced at $10,500 USD, the watch is now available via TAG Heuer. TAG Heuer has reunited with Japanese racing icon Team Ikuzawa and Bamford Watch Department for a new collaborative Carrera Chronograph. Following their initial 2023 collaboration, this new limited-edition release channels the visual codes of 1970s and 1980s Japanese motorsport through a contemporary lens. Spearheaded by Team Principal Mai Ikuzawa alongside George Bamford, the project draws direct creative inspiration from the Team Ikuzawa archive, specifically reinterpreting the graphic aesthetic and high legibility of the team's historic Roadmaster stopwatch.Housed in a 39mm fine-brushed and polished steel "Glassbox" case, the timepiece boasts a bezel-free construction and domed sapphire crystal, offering an uninterrupted view of the dial. The white dial features a textured Clou de Paris finish and printed numeral indexes that mimic vintage timing instruments. Highlighting the team's signature color palette, bold red accents appear on the lacquered hour and minute hands, central chronograph seconds hand, red-printed 3 o'clock minute counter and a dedicated date disc at 6 o'clock.Powering the watch is the in-house Calibre TH20-10 automatic chronograph movement, which intentionally omits a running seconds subdial. This specific 2-counter layout leaves the 6 o'clock dial space open for the prominent Team Ikuzawa logo, paying homage to vintage 1960s and 1970s racing chronographs. The watch is delivered on a 7-row steel bracelet and comes bundled as a set with two additional interchangeable straps: a white perforated leather strap with red stitching inspired by classic driving gloves, and a red-and-white striped textile strap referencing Team Ikuzawa's racing livery. Its custom sapphire caseback is engraved with "TEAM IKUZAWA", "BAMFORD WATCH DEPARTMENT," alongside its individual issue number.The Carrera Chronograph x Team Ikuzawa is presented in custom packaging designed to emjlate a pit garage toolbox, alongside a travel pouch and branded charms. items.title: Callum Turner Toasts to His Latest Role as Johnnie Walker Blue Label’s Global Ambassador
items.text: Callum Turner Toasts to His Latest Role as Johnnie Walker Blue Label’s Global Ambassador Johnnie Walker Blue Label has named Hollywood star Callum Turner as its latest global ambassador. Uniting for a year-long partnership, the appointment underscores the values of craftsmanship and progress that have long been associated with the luxury Scotch. Having recently starred in Eternity alongside Elizabeth Olsen and set to make his debut as Owen in the romantic comedy One Night Only, Turner’s latest role with Johnnie Walker Blue Label comes at a unique time in his burgeoning career. With the brand recognizing his continued rise in cinema and beyond, it aims to celebrate the actor’s natural flair for bringing style and dynamism to the leading characters he portrays.In a first look at the partnership, Johnnie Walker Blue Label reveals a new video that follows Turner as he raises a glass of whisky. The intimate visuals show how he marks the moments that matter through celebrations, rituals, and reflections. A message of “Keep Walking is also captured in a profound closing sequence, highlighting the parallels between the spirit of Johnnie Walker Blue Label and the actor’s pursuit to forge his own path.“The ethos of Johnnie Walker Blue Label is one that I've always admired,” mentioned Turner in an official statement on the appointment. “With only one in ten thousand casks ever making it in, that level of care is what sets it apart. Blue Label is the first bottle I reach for when celebrating with my mates, and now to officially be in partnership is a real honor.”Continuing to immerse himself in the world of Johnnie Walker Blue Label, the actor will soon head to Scotland to discover more about its heritage and what goes into making his celebratory drink of choice. Turner’s travels along with other collaborative moments will give fans a closer look at the partnership. "For over 200 years, Johnnie Walker has championed progress in all its forms, and Johnnie Walker Blue Label stands as its ultimate expression,” shares Global Brand Director of Johnnie Walker, Neil Shah. “Callum embodies that same spirit: quietly persistent, endlessly dedicated to his craft, forging his own path while staying true to his roots. We're proud to welcome him to the Johnnie Walker Blue Label family as he enters the next chapter of his journey, celebrating his continued rise as an icon of style and screen through the Keep Walking spirit."Find out more about the appointment on Johnnie Walker Blue

items.title: Six Flags Is Building "Bakunawa," a Record-Breaking Spinning Giga Coaster
items.text: Six Flags Is Building "Bakunawa," a Record-Breaking Spinning Giga Coaster Summary Six Flags Great Adventure unveiled Bakunawa, a record-breaking spinning giga coaster inspired by Philippine mythology slated to open in 2027The ride will feature world-record-setting statistics including a 382-foot height, 100-mph top speed and the first floorless spinning coaster trainsBakunawa serves as the centerpiece of a multi-year transformation for the park's Boardwalk district Six Flags Great Adventure has officially revealed Bakunawa, a massive new attraction set to become the world's tallest and fastest spinning roller coaster when it opens in 2027. Named after a legendary sea serpent from Philippine mythology, the giga coaster serves as the culmination of the park's highly anticipated Project Purple teaser campaign. The addition represents a major investment in the resort's ongoing transformation of its Boardwalk district.Bakunawa is engineered to shatter six world records. Riders will experience the fastest inversion at 80 mph and the first upside-down launch in coaster history. Utilizing free-spinning and floorless 20-passenger trains that rotate independently throughout the two-minute and 17-second journey, the attraction aims to provide a unique visual and physical sensation for every passenger across its 3,163 feet of track. The coaster features three distinct linear synchronous motor launches, beginning with an initial blast from zero to 60 mph.After ascending high above the park, a final launch will propel guests to an exhilarating 100 mph before plunging down a 382-foot drop. The layout also incorporates the world's longest stall inversion and a sweeping 180-degree bank spiral that offers sweeping views of the surrounding New Jersey landscape. To board Bakunawa, guests will need to meet a minimum height requirement of 48 inches. Park officials anticipate the massive structure will join an elite class of giga coasters globally.The monumental project acts as the signature anchor for a revitalized seashore-themed area at the property. Representatives position the record-breaking construction as a defining milestone in a broader strategy to solidify the location as a premier regional destination for thrill-seekers. The nearby grounds recently received five new family attractions and introduced seasonal nighttime entertainment to encourage visitors to spend more time exploring the modernized space. items.title: LeBron James Breaks the All-Time Jersey Sales Record After Signing With the Philadelphia 76ers
items.text: LeBron James Breaks the All-Time Jersey Sales Record After Signing With the Philadelphia 76ers Summary Fanatics announced that LeBron James' No. 23 Philadelphia 76ers jersey set an all-time record for the most sales within 48 hours of a player joining a new teamThe historic debut surpassed the previous global record set by Shohei Ohtani's move to the Los Angeles Dodgers in 2023James' merchandise dominated the retail market since his July 24 signing and accounted for eight of the top 10 best-selling products across the Fanatics network LeBron James officially broke the record for the biggest jersey debut in sports history following his decision to join the Philadelphia 76ers for the 2026-27 NBA season. According to data from Fanatics, the four-time champion's No. 23 jersey eclipsed the 48-hour sales mark previously held by Shohei Ohtani when he joined the Los Angeles Dodgers in December 2023. The unprecedented retail demand proves the legendary forward remains a massive cultural draw as he enters his 24th professional campaign.The superstar's arrival in Philadelphia sparked an immediate frenzy among supporters. More 76ers merchandise sold in the initial 24 hours after his decision than his Lakers apparel moved during its entire first week back in 2018. While specific unit figures remain undisclosed, multiple colorways of the Icon Edition uniform completely sold out on the official league retail platform within 72 hours before being restocked. The intense commercial response highlights a monumental shift in the sports landscape as basketball's premier talent relocates to an Eastern Conference heavyweight.Prior to this momentous occasion, Ohtani set the global standard by surpassing previous highs established by international soccer icons Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. James securing this milestone cements his status as an unparalleled marketing juggernaut. He recently inked a two-year contract worth $8 million with the organization after spending eight seasons in Los Angeles. His signature merchandise accounted for eight of the top 10 best-selling items across all sports on the Fanatics network in the days following the announcement.The combination of a massive free agency splash and a fiercely loyal fan base has pushed optimism in the City of Brotherly Love to new heights. items.title: Michael B. Jordan Steals to Right Old Wrongs in Teaser for ‘The Thomas Crown Affair’
items.text: Michael B. Jordan Steals to Right Old Wrongs in Teaser for ‘The Thomas Crown Affair’ Summary Michael B. Jordan directs, produces and stars in Amazon MGM's reimagining of 'The Thomas Crown Affair,' the third screen take on the art-thief storyHis version rewrites the character's motive, sending Crown after stolen or sold artifacts to return them to their rightful creatorsAdria Arjona plays the former FBI agent tracking him heist by heist while Kenneth Branagh circles as a looming threat Amazon MGM Studios has released the trailer for The Thomas Crown Affair, Michael B. Jordan's reimagining of the billionaire art-thief story that puts a pointed new spin on the character's heists. Jordan directs and stars as Crown in the third screen iteration of the tale, and the footage frames the theft less as a rich man's sport than as a mission with a conscience.The reframe is the whole point. Where earlier versions cast Crown as a wealthy thrill-seeker, Jordan's take gives him a cause: his true aim is to return precious stolen or sold artifacts to the people who created them. That motive reshapes the cat-and-mouse structure the franchise is known for, with Adria Arjona playing the former FBI agent hunting Crown heist by heist and Kenneth Branagh lurking as an insidious antagonist threatening to bring him down. The result reads as a heist thriller with its moral compass deliberately recalibrated.Jordan has been explicit about why he rebuilt the story from the ground up. He told Variety in November, “I didn’t want a reboot. I wanted a reimagination. The first two films were about rich white guys stealing for fun. That doesn’t land today.” He continued, “Ours is more personal. The stakes are higher. Still got the fashion, romance.”The production carries a notable pedigree behind the camera as well. Drew Pearce wrote the script from a previous draft by Wes Tooke and Justin Britt-Gibson, working from the 1968 original that starred Steve McQueen and Faye Dunaway, the film later remade in 1999 with Pierce Brosnan and Rene Russo. Jordan produces alongside Elizabeth Raposo for Outlier Society, with Charles Roven for Atlas Entertainment, plus Patrick McCormick and Toberoff Productions' Marc Toberoff. Alan Trustman, who wrote the original film, executive produces. The trailer first debuted at CinemaCon in April, arriving with Jordan fresh off his Best Actor Oscar win for Sinners, his first Academy nomination and victory, earned for Ryan Coogler's vampire horror film.Watch the tease

items.title: Thuso Mbedu Summons the Magic of Orïsha in the First 'Children of Blood and Bone’ Trailer
items.text: Thuso Mbedu Summons the Magic of Orïsha in the First 'Children of Blood and Bone’ Trailer Summary Paramount's first look at 'Children of Blood and Bone' introduces Thuso Mbedu as Zélie, a young warrior fighting to restore magic to the kingdom of OrïshaThe ensemble stacks Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Regina King, Idris Elba, Cynthia Erivo and Viola Davis beneath director Gina Prince-BythewoodTems and Burna Boy anchor the film's music while the trailer moves to an excerpt of Beyoncé's "Energy" Paramount Pictures has dropped the first trailer for Children of Blood and Bone, the big-screen adaptation of Tomi Adeyemi's 2018 bestseller, and it lands with the scale of a full-blown blockbuster. The clip pulls back the curtain on Orïsha, a mythic pre-colonial West African kingdom where magic has been violently stripped from the people, and centers Thuso Mbedu as Zélie Adebola, the young maji at the heart of the fight to bring it back.The footage wastes no time flexing its ambition. Sweeping location photography, large-scale battle sequences and creature-heavy VFX build out a world divided into clans, each wielding its own elemental gift, from those who bend water, fire, wind and earth to seers who can read the past and future. Mbedu's Zélie, gifted with the power to command undead spirits, moves through it all as a coming-of-age heroine dodging the forces of a ruthless king, played by Backrooms star Chiwetel Ejiofor.Behind the camera is Gina Prince-Bythewood, returning to the epic register she commanded on The Woman King, and she brings collaborators with her: Mbedu, Viola Davis and Lashana Lynch all reunite from that 2022 hit. The rest of the call sheet reads like a fantasy fan's wish list. Damson Idris and Amandla Stenberg play the king's children, Prince Inan and Princess Amari, while Tosin Cole, Regina King, Idris Elba and Cynthia Erivo round out a genuinely stacked ensemble.Then there's the sound. Paramount has loaded the project with serious musical firepower, tapping Tems as executive music producer and Burna Boy as executive music consultant, both attached to deliver original songs. The trailer itself rides an excerpt of Beyoncé's 2022 track "Energy," a needle-drop that signals exactly how big this swing is meant to feel.Watch the trailer above. Children of Blood and Bone opens in theaters and IMAX on January 15, 2027. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Everything Coming to and Leaving Netflix in August 2026
items.text: Everything Coming to and Leaving Netflix in August 2026 Summary Netflix's August 2026 slate stacks the first seven 'Fast & Furious' films, a near-complete 'Child's Play' run and a wave of horror alongside returning originals'Outer Banks' returns for its fifth season on August 20, sending the Pogues off on another treasure huntNew original seasons, stand-up specials and documentaries fill out the calendar through the end of the month Netflix has locked in its August 2026 lineup, and the month plays like a summer blowout built for genre fans. The headline draw for the streamer's culture-forward crowd is the return of Outer Banks, whose fifth season, which Netflix has billed as the show's last, drops August 20 to send the Pogues off on a final treasure hunt. Around it, the platform loads up on horror, franchise marathons and a fresh batch of originals.The month front-loads the nostalgia on August 1. The first seven Fast & Furious films arrive in a single drop, joined by a near-complete run of the Child's Play franchise, the '90s touchstone Clueless, Jake Gyllenhaal's Nightcrawler and the Keanu Reeves thriller Speed. Horror keeps building from there, with Five Nights at Freddy's 2 on August 3, Blake Lively's shark thriller The Shallows on August 15, and the killer-doll reboot M3GAN on August 24.On the originals side, the returning-series calendar is deep. My Life With the Walter Boys comes back for its third season on August 6, followed by Tires Season 3 on August 13, Love Is Blind: UK Season 3 on August 19, and Outer Banks on August 20. items.title: McDonald's China Rebuilds Its Takeaway Bag Into the Fry-Toting "Big Fries Backpack"
items.text: McDonald's China Rebuilds Its Takeaway Bag Into the Fry-Toting "Big Fries Backpack" Summary McDonald's China has turned its instantly recognizable brown paper takeaway bag into a wearable backpack for the 12th edition of Big Fries DayThe build layers on functional detailing, from Velcro fry-carton side pockets to a padded interior sized for a laptopThe design began as a fan's handmade tribute before McDonald's China developed it into an official product McDonald's China has turned its most familiar piece of packaging into a bag you can actually wear, and the Big Fries Backpack commits to the bit at every seam. Rather than slap a logo onto a blank silhouette, the brand modeled the whole thing on the brown paper takeaway bag that leaves the counter with every order, then engineered in enough real utility to move it past pure novelty.The construction starts with the shell. The exterior uses a lightweight DuPont paper material chosen to mimic the crinkle and texture of a genuine takeaway bag, printed with the Golden Arches up front alongside fry graphics and folded-bag detailing that sell the illusion. A detachable charm shaped like a McDonald's order receipt dangles off the body, while the zipper pulls are molded to resemble individual fries dipped in ketchup, so even the smallest touchpoints stay on theme.The most eye-catching engineering sits on the sides. A pair of red pockets shaped like McDonald's fry cartons attach to either flank with Velcro and are built to hold actual fries, though McDonald's leaves the wisdom of pressing greasy food against a paper-textured bag to the owner. Those pockets pull off cleanly when a slimmer profile is wanted, and the interior hides a compartment reserved specifically for ketchup packets, a small but telling nod to how completely the design maps to the ordering ritual.Where the exterior leans into spectacle, the inside gets practical. The main compartment is fitted with dividers and sized to take a 13- or 14-inch laptop, which reframes the backpack as a viable daily commuter rather than a one-off gag. The shoulder strap continues the theme with a holder built to keep a fry carton upright, a detail that reads as either clever ergonomics or a public statement of priorities depending on your appetite.The Big Fries Backpack is available exclusively via McDonald’s China. As ever with JJJJound, the changes are deliberate and quiet: suede treatments dress the upper, a leather lining adds a premium hand, and JJJJound detailing on the insoles supplies the signature. Beyond those touches, the shoe stays close to the standard Mostro, the kind of restrained reworking that rewards a second look rather than shouting for attention. items.text: BTS Withdraws From 2027 GRAMMYs, Recording Academy CEO "Saddened" Over Group’s Decision Summary All seven BTS members announced they will not submit music for consideration at the 69th GRAMMY AwardsThe decision follows the Recording Academy's rollout of a new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category that requires meaningful use of an Asian languageGRAMMY CEO Harvey Mason Jr. responded that he respects the group's choice while defending the category's intent BTS is officially sitting out the 2027 GRAMMY Awards. In a coordinated statement shared across all seven members' personal Instagram accounts, the group announced they will not submit their comeback album ARIRANG for consideration. The boycott arrives just a month after the Recording Academy announced the creation of a new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category.Rather than capping their reunion with a push for the golden gramophones, the septet is taking a principled stance against the Academy's categorization. In their shared announcement, BTS was direct about their reasoning. "We decided not to participate in the GRAMMYs this year," the message read. "We hope our music can be heard and loved for what it is, rather than being divided by region or language. We thank Army and everyone who has always stood by us."Following the announcement, Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. took to social media to clarify the Academy's intent and address the fallout. "I am saddened to hear that BTS has chosen not to participate in the GRAMMY Awards process this year, but as a music creator, I understand and respect their decision," Mason Jr. stated. "I do want to clarify something that seems to be getting lost in the conversation. The Asian Pop category was created to celebrate the depth, diversity and extraordinary growth of pop artistry coming out of Asia. The spirit of this new category is to shine a dedicated spotlight on these important artists. More categories mean more artists' work is recognized. It's never to divide, but to expand who is recognized by our 15,000 GRAMMY voters."Mason Jr. also emphasized that the new category does not restrict artists from top tier nominations. "I also want to be very clear: submitting music in a genre category such as Asian Pop, or Jazz or Country does not exclude an artist from also submitting and being considered in the General Field categories, including Record of the Year, Album of the Year and Song of the Year," he added. items.text: Jacques Marie Mage Marks Its First Decade With the “Iconographies” Collection Jacques Marie Mage has unveiled its Summer 2026 “Iconographies” Collection, celebrates the enduring cultural figures that have shaped the Maison’s visual imagination over the past decade. Photographed by Horst Diekgerdes, the campaign assembles a diverse cast of models whose personas subtly recall artists, musicians, filmmakers and provocateurs, reinforcing the brand's fascination with identity and cultural memory.Anchored by the theme "Rebirth of the Icon," the collection revisits some of the brand's most celebrated archival silhouettes while introducing advanced material innovations and manufacturing techniques. items.title: A Closer Look at What to Expect in ‘NBA 2K27’
items.text: A Closer Look at What to Expect in ‘NBA 2K27’ For the upcoming release of NBA 2K27, gaming publisher 2K has launched a dedicated trailer capturing the action and graphics of the latest video game. The premiere of the trailer comes after last week’s announcement of the game’s new cover athletes. On a trilogy of images, San Antonio Spurs Center Victor Wembanyama was unveiled as headliner for the Standard edition, three-time WNBA All-Star starter Caitlin Clark landed in the visuals for the Deluxe edition, while Derrick Rose, the Chicago Bulls star and youngest MVP in NBA history, headed up the Ultra edition campaign. Bringing fans in for a closer look at the game, the trailer showcases clips of the basketballers on the court alongside Philadelphia 76ers’ latest signing, LeBron James, and new Miami Heat acquisition, Giannis Antetokounmpo. The graphics and gameplay also appear to have become more dynamic compared to NBA 2K26 with the introduction of a timed dunk meter as well as AI Defenders that bring precision to contesting shots. Other features not seen in the trailer include the addition of 19 new badges in the MyPLAYER Builder and the return of Cap Breakers, which can now be previewed and optimized before competitions. Beyond the court, the gaming publisher has unveiled several updates to The City setting. One of these is the arrival of the iconic street basketball landmark, Rucker Park, which lands amongst The REC, Arena, and other key locations to add another layer of basketball culture to the simulation game. Watch the full gameplay trailer in the gallery above, and be sure to stay tuned to Hypebeast for more on the video game.NBA 2K27 is available to buy on September 4, 2026, with early access to the special edition beginning August 28. The upcoming seasonal range merges industrial workwear, high-performance technical outerwear, nostalgic pop-culture graphics and devotional iconography into a versatile, transition-ready lineup.Outerwear stands as a major highlight of the range, anchored by heavy-duty fabrications and collaborative pieces. Leading the lineup is a standout partnership with Avirex, yielding a heavy leather jacket decorated with a winged Eagle skull emblem and co-branded gothic typography across the back. items.text: Vollebak’s Ultra-Limited FWAHBL Jacket is Made From Chemical Protection Gear Summary Vollebak drops the hazard-yellow FWAHBL Jacket, limited to 10 pieces worldwide and priced at $3,995 USD.Engineered from double-faced polychloroprene rubber by Fothergill to resist chemicals, flame, and extreme weather.Comes in retro video game packaging alongside a comic book, trailer and upcoming video game. Experimental gear maker Vollebak has released the FWAHBL (For When All Hell Breaks Loose) Jacket, a limited-edition trench coat engineered from high-grade chemical-suit material.Strictly capped at just 10 pieces worldwide and finished entirely in a striking hazard yellow, the jacket is constructed from double-faced polychloroprene rubber coated over a woven polyester core. The ultra-durable textile is produced by Fothergill - a historic British manufacturer supplying protective gear to the military since 1847 - and is specifically designed to resist oils, ozone, weathering, flame and chemical exposure. Built to tackle extreme weather with a touch of existential dread, the coat comes packaged inside its own custom garment bag crafted from the very same chemical-suit fabric.Beyond its construction, the FWAHBL Jacket arrives as part of a larger fictional universe. Each piece ships in retro video game-inspired packaging, accompanied by a Marvel-style comic strip and a film-style trailer, with a playable game currently in development. This narrative-driven approach transforms the jacket into more than functional apparel — it becomes a collectible artifact that merges fashion, gaming, and storytelling. While not certified safety equipment, the jacket is designed for extreme weather and existential dread, reflecting Vollebak’s ethos of creating clothing for the challenges of the future.Priced at $3,995 USD, the FWAHBL Jacket is available via Vollebak's official website. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Vollebak (@vollebak) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Disney+ Cancels Marvel's 'Wonder Man' Despite Earlier Season 2 Renewal Summary Disney+ has canceled Marvel Studios' 'Wonder Man' despite an earlier Season 2 renewalAccording to reports a writers' room was never opened and the writing staff has been releasedCharacters from the eight-episode show could still appear in future Marvel Cinematic Universe projects Disney+ has reportedly canceled Marvel Studios' Wonder Man despite formally renewing the series for a second season back in March. The streaming service rescinded its Season 2 order for the Yahya Abdul-Mateen II-led superhero series.Variety recently received reports from insiders that a writers' room for the second season was never opened, and the show's writers have been released to pursue other projects. Created by Destin Daniel Cretton and Andrew Guest, the eight-episode freshman season starred Yahya Abdul-Mateen II as Simon Williams alongside Ben Kingsley as Trevor Slattery. Despite earning an Emmy nomination for Abdul-Mateen II and strong critical acclaim, Disney+ ultimately opted not to move forward with production.While the series will not return for a second installment, sources report that characters featured in Wonder Man could still appear in future Marvel Cinematic Universe projects down the line. items.text: Spotify Introduces New "User Notes" Feature for In-App Music Journaling Summary Spotify introduced "User Notes" to let listeners attach personal memories and custom captions directly to individual songs within their playlists.The journaling feature transforms standard audio collections into digital scrapbooks that document where and why users discovered specific tracks.The tool is available to free and premium subscribers aged 16 and older in select markets and remains visible to anyone who can view the targeted playlist. Spotify officially launched "User Notes" to allow listeners to attach custom captions and personal memories directly to individual tracks within their playlists. The global streaming service designed the update to provide audiences with a dedicated space for music journaling. Listeners can now permanently document the specific reasons why a song holds significance. The platform aims to preserve the emotional connections tied to everyday listening habits.The functionality encourages users to record the exact context behind a particular musical discovery or playlist addition. An individual could highlight hearing a specific track while exploring the streets of Paris on vacation or note that a song played constantly during a memorable first date. By allowing users to capture these distinct life events, the application shifts standard playlists from simple audio collections into highly personalized digital scrapbooks. Spotify stated that these annotations will gradually paint a detailed picture of the music listeners love and the unique moments that shaped those preferences.Navigating the interface involves a straightforward process for anyone utilizing the application. Listeners must first open a playlist they created themselves or access a collection containing tracks they manually added. Tapping the three-dot menu located next to a chosen song reveals a new option to add a note. The interface then opens a text box where the user can type their memory before saving the caption. These customized annotations immediately become visible to anyone who possesses permission to view the broader playlist. The system also automatically links the creator's display name directly to their public profile alongside the published text.This specific product launch heavily reflects broader company efforts to deepen user engagement through extreme personalization. items.text: Netflix and AMC Ink $500 Million USD Deal to Co-Stream Entire ‘The Walking Dead’ Universe Summary Netflix and AMC Global Media have struck a $500 million USD co-exclusive licensing deal for the entire 'The Walking Dead' franchiseThe five-year pact covers 371 episodes across the original show and all six spinoff series starting in 2027Under the new agreement AMC+ will stream the flagship series for the first time while Netflix expands international access Netflix and AMC Global Media have officially inked a five-year, $500 million USD co-exclusive global licensing deal to share streaming rights for the complete The Walking Dead universe. The massive agreement covers 371 episodes across the flagship series and all six spinoffs starting in 2027.The unprecedented partnership covers the original The Walking Dead alongside Fear the Walking Dead, The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, The Walking Dead: Dead City, The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live, The Walking Dead: World Beyond, and Tales of The Walking Dead. Under the terms of the agreement, AMC+ will stream the original flagship series for the first time after Netflix held exclusive U.S. streaming rights since 2011.In addition to maintaining its U.S. presence, Netflix will expand availability for the full television franchise across international territories, including the U.K., Italy, Australia, and New Zealand, as existing regional licensing deals expire.The complete The Walking Dead universe begins streaming co-exclusively on Netflix and AMC+ in 2027. items.text: Samsung Electronics Posts Record $62 Billion USD Operating Profit Driven by AI Boom Summary Samsung Electronics reported a record Q2 2026 operating profit of approx. $62 billion USD, driven by surging AI demand.Stock prices fell despite earnings due to heavy capital spending and rising competition from Chinese semiconductor firms. Samsung Electronics has achieved unprecedented financial milestones for the second quarter of 2026. The conglomerate reported a record operating profit of ₩89.5 trillion KRW ($62 billion USD) alongside an all-time high revenue of ₩171.5 trillion KRW ($119 billion USD). This monumental growth stems directly from the ongoing global artificial intelligence boom. Crosstown rival SK Hynix similarly capitalized on the frenzy by posting its own record revenue of ₩60.5 trillion KRW. Together, the two giants control roughly two-thirds of the global memory chip market and are aggressively steering production to meet skyrocketing demand for high-bandwidth memory components.Despite these historic earnings, both manufacturers saw their stock prices tumble on the volatile South Korean exchange this week. Investors are reportedly growing anxious about the massive capital expenditures required to increase manufacturing capacity. Fears are also mounting over intensifying competition from China following reports of state-owned enterprises mass-producing advanced lithography machines. The recent market debut of Chinese competitor ChangXin Memory Technologies further amplified these anxieties among shareholders.To mitigate long-term market risks and secure captive demand, Samsung is locking corporate clients into multi-year supply agreements. Corporate representatives indicated that these contracts will secure up to 70 percent of the brand's total DRAM supply as experts forecast semiconductor shortages persisting through 2028. The strategy aims to shield the chipmaker from future demand fluctuations while guaranteeing major tech entities reliable access to essential AI infrastructure.Production capabilities are expanding internationally to support this aggressive roadmap. Samsung plans to begin construction on a second semiconductor fabrication plant in Taylor, Texas later this year with a target operational date of 2030. South Korean leadership is also stepping in to cement these tech alliances. items.title: Leaked 25-Page Sales Deck Reveals FIFA's Plan to Sell 20% Commercial Stake
items.text: Leaked 25-Page Sales Deck Reveals FIFA's Plan to Sell 20% Commercial Stake Summary A leaked FIFA commercia deck proposed selling a 20% stake in a new commercial entity to American investor Joshua Kushner for $20 million USD sign-up payments per federation.The proposal relies on expanding global events from 200 to 450 annually, triggering severe concerns regarding player burnout and scheduling congestion. A confidential 25-page sales deck has exposed an aggressive commercial roadmap for world football. The prospectus reveals a proposal from the governing body to sell a 20 percent stake in its commercial operations to American investor Joshua Kushner. Drafted by the same bank behind the failed European Super League, the document outlines the creation of a new commercial entity dubbed FIFA Forward Enterprise. To secure backing from 211 member associations, executives have offered an immediate $20 million USD sign-up payment. Projected distributions would subsequently rise to $24 million USD per cycle by 2035. The overarching goal centers on bridging a perceived revenue gap. The pitch compares current global football earnings unfavorably to major domestic franchises like the NFL to argue the organization remains undermonetized.Unlocking that promised capital requires a massive overhaul of the international sporting calendar. The growth strategy relies heavily on expanding the tournament portfolio from 200 to 450 global events each year. Such a drastic increase raises immediate concerns regarding extreme player burnout and scheduling congestion. Financial growth would also stem from higher ticket prices, prioritized high-yield partnerships and a pivot toward subscription-based broadcasting models for major tournaments. Critics have been quick to question the logic of the financial restructuring. Senior football figures noted the absurdity of taking on third-party debt financing when the organization currently holds around $4 billion in cash reserves and boasts accumulated revenues of $15 billion USD over the current four-year cycle.President Gianni Infantino set a firm September 19, 2026, deadline for member associations to accept the deal. The ultimatum sparked immediate mutiny across the highest levels of the sport. European governing body UEFA announced a unanimous rejection of the plan and threatened a total boycott of all connected competitions until the proposal is completely abandoned. items.title: A Rare Porsche Carrera GT Finished in Ferrari’s 'Rosso Fuoco' Red Heads to Auction
items.text: A Rare Porsche Carrera GT Finished in Ferrari’s 'Rosso Fuoco' Red Heads to Auction Summary A rare 2005 Porsche Carrera GT finished in Ferrari’s iconic Rosso Fuoco red is heading to Mecum Monterey.Featuring a bare-tub repainting, the 3,471-mile supercar retains its original 603-horsepower naturally aspirated V10 and six-speed manual.Driven by a boom in unique specification supercars, similar low-mileage models regularly command between $2 million and $3.5 million USD. The 2005 Porsche Carrera GT represents a high-water mark for analogue supercars. Now a distinctly unique example of the legendary vehicle is heading to the auction block. One of only 644 units originally delivered to the US, this specific Carrera GT was meticulously stripped to its bare carbon fiber tub for a concours-quality repaint by Karosserie in Wayne, Pennsylvania. The project utilized modern triple-layer paint technology to apply a striking Rosso Fuoco finish. The metallic red shade replaces the car's original GT Silver factory paint to create a rare visual crossover between Porsche engineering and Ferrari aesthetics.Noted Ferrari enthusiast Milton Verret commissioned the transformation. Blending the signature hue of the Prancing Horse with a flagship Stuttgart silhouette could easily misfire. However, the custom exterior perfectly highlights the aggressive lines of the German supercar. Beyond the intensive three-month exterior overhaul, the interior remains immaculate. The cabin features pristine black leather seating alongside the iconic lightweight carbon fiber shift knob. The factory-original hydraulic rear spoiler actuators were also updated with a specially engineered electrical system to ensure modern reliability.Underneath the removable roof panels, the vehicle retains its original Formula 1-derived 5.7-liter naturally aspirated V10 engine. The powerplant delivers 603 horsepower and 435 lb-ft of torque directly to the rear wheels through a six-speed manual transmission and a two-disc ceramic dry clutch. Stopping power comes courtesy of four-wheel ventilated carbon ceramic disc brakes paired with six-piston fixed alloy calipers. With just 3,471 miles on the odometer, the mechanical components remain preserved and ready for open-air driving.Scheduled to cross the block as Lot S74 at the Mecum Monterey auction on August 15, 2026, the customized vehicle arrives during a major surge in Carrera GT market demand.
