items.title: How Simon Weckert’s "Digital Camouflage" Garments Use Adversarial Attacks to Fool AI Cameras
items.text: How Simon Weckert’s "Digital Camouflage" Garments Use Adversarial Attacks to Fool AI Cameras Summary Simon Weckert debuted "Digital Camouflage," an apparel collection engineered to trick AI surveillance.Generative patterns prevent camera detection from any angle or fabric fold.Digital printing applies visual noise onto recycled polyester textiles. Berlin-based artist Simon Weckert is pushing back against the rise of ubiquitous digital surveillance with his 2025 installation. The designer officially unveiled "Digital Camouflage," a conceptual garment collection that serves as a wearable shield against AI-driven tracking systems. As artificial intelligence continues to dominate public spaces through automated tracking cameras, personal privacy has become a highly debated topic. This project explores the boundaries of anonymity and visibility in modern society. By merging computational noise with everyday apparel, Weckert offers a physical countermeasure to digital overreach.At first glance, the clothing appears to feature nothing more than a striking abstract graphic pattern. The collection is actually a highly engineered tool specifically developed to disrupt object-recognition algorithms used in security and autonomous systems. This design approach relies on the concept of an adversarial attack. The technique deliberately manipulates the visual data received by a machine so that it incorrectly interprets the scene. When an individual wears the collection, their body essentially becomes invisible to AI person detectors because the software completely fails to identify the human figure amidst the high-frequency visual noise.Previous attempts to evade machine vision typically relied on fixed printed patches or isolated graphics. Those early designs shared a critical vulnerability known as the segment-missing problem, where the illusion breaks down the moment the fabric folds or the camera angle changes. Weckert solves this technical hurdle by deploying a seamless Adversarial Texture that covers the entire surface of each piece. A specialized generative AI method called TC-EGA generates the continuous pattern. This computational approach optimizes a tileable textile design that constantly produces false visual features regardless of the viewing perspective.Physical production of the garments matches the meticulous nature of the software engineering behind them. Manufacturers in Latvia construct the collection using a durable blend of 65 percent recycled polyes

items.title: Dave Bautista in Talks to Star as Kratos in Amazon's 'God of War' Series
items.text: Dave Bautista in Talks to Star as Kratos in Amazon's 'God of War' Series Summary Dave Bautista is in negotiations to star as Kratos in Prime Video’s live-action 'God of War' adaptationThe potential recasting follows original lead Ryan Hurst exiting the project after suffering a torn bicepRonald D Moore serves as showrunner and writer for the two-season series produced alongside Sony Pictures Television Amazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television are currently in negotiations with Dave Bautista to star as Kratos in the upcoming live-action God of War series. The potential casting follows original lead Ryan Hurst exiting the project due to an on-set injury.Hurst, who was cast in January 2026, suffered a torn bicep during production, prompting Amazon and Sony to recast the role in order to resume filming by the fall. Bautista, who maintains an established relationship with Amazon MGM Studios through films like The Wrecking Crew and My Spy, brings the physique required for the lead character without requiring extended physical prep time.The two-season series order adapts the narrative of the franchise's recent video games, following Kratos and his ten-year-old son Atreus—played by Callum Vinson—as they journey across the Norse realm. Developed by showrunner and writer Ronald D. Moore, the project features an ensemble cast including Mandy Patinkin as Odin, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, Ed Skrein as Baldur, and Max Parker as Heimdall. items.text: BAPE and MEDICOM TOY Revive 2003 Camo for 30th Anniversary Collection Summary BAPE and MEDICOM TOY have teamed up to revive their archival 2003 camouflage pattern in celebration of MEDICOM TOY’s 30th anniversaryThe capsule features a BE@R SHARK full-zip reversible hoodie, a matching BAPE STA, graphic tees, and new BE@RBRICK figuresThe collection drops on August 8 in limited quantities via BAPE and select MEDICOM TOY locations in Japan BAPE and MEDICOM TOY have officially reunited to release the BAPE x MEDICOM TOY 30th anniversary collection. The collaborative capsule revisits the duo's archival 2003 camouflage pattern to celebrate MEDICOM TOY's 30th anniversary milestone.The revived camouflage print takes center stage across the BE@R SHARK Full Zip Reversible Hoodie and a matching BAPE STA sneaker. The broader apparel assortment incorporates graphic T-shirts showcasing COLLEGE MILO and BUSY WORKS artwork, alongside a glow-in-the-dark BAPE x BE@RBRICK logo.Accompanying the clothing and footwear, the release highlights new BE@RBRICK collectibles outfitted in the classic SHARK HOODIE theme. The figures will be offered in a set containing both 100% and 400% sizes, while the standalone 1000% figure will be sold separately.The BAPE x MEDICOM TOY 30th Anniversary Collection releases August 8, 2026, in limited quantities via BAPE, BAPE STORE locations, and select MEDICOM TOY locations in Japan. items.title: ‘Final Fantasy X’ 25th Anniversary Capsule Arrives at Daimaru Matsuzakaya
items.text: ‘Final Fantasy X’ 25th Anniversary Capsule Arrives at Daimaru Matsuzakaya Summary 'Final Fantasy X' 25th Anniversary Collection launches via Daimaru Matsuzakaya with Square Enix.Apparel and accessories feature character-inspired designs and immersive pop-up installations.Available for a limited time, priced around $10 – $244 USD. In celebration of the 25th anniversary of Final Fantasy X, Japanese department store group Daimaru Matsuzakaya has partnered with Square Enix to launch a commemorative capsule collection. Bridging the iconic role-playing game's rich world of Spira with modern Japanese craftsmanship, the special project delivers a range of apparel and lifestyle goods.The apparel lineup comprises staple pieces such as varsity jackets, graphic tees, hoodies and light outerwear, incorporated with designs that pay homage to characters like Tidus, Yuna, Auron and Kimahri. Accessories expand the range with co-branded bags, caps, backpacks and collectible key rings, each designed to capture the emotional resonance of the game while remaining wearable and functional.A special pop-up within Daimaru Matsuzakaya department stores, recreating iconic settings from Final Fantasy X to enhance the shopping experience. The collection will be available for a limited time at select Daimaru Matsuzakaya locations and online, with prices ranging from ¥1,540 - ¥38,500 JPY (approx. $10 - $244 USD). items.title: Paulin, Paulin, Paulin Brings Dune Seating to Fred again.. and Latin Mafia's Mexico Creative Retreat
items.text: Paulin, Paulin, Paulin Brings Dune Seating to Fred again.. and Latin Mafia's Mexico Creative Retreat Summary Paulin, Paulin, Paulin has installed its iconic Dune seating system for Fred again.. and Latin Mafia’s creative retreat in MexicoSet up by Benjamin Paulin at Lago Algo, the modular landscape formed the creative heart for their collaborative mixtape '9 months & 50 hours'Originally designed by Pierre Paulin in 1970, the setup was featured throughout a YouTube livestream documenting the recording process Paulin, Paulin, Paulin has partnered with music artists Fred again.. and Latin Mafia to create a bespoke installation featuring its iconic Dune seating system at Lago Algo in Bosque de Chapultepec, Mexico. The sculptural setup served as the central workspace for the artists while writing and recording their collaborative mixtape, 9 months & 50 hours.Personally installed by Benjamin Paulin, the Dune modules established a fluid, open environment designed to foster conversation, movement, and spontaneous creation. The modular landscape was captured throughout an ongoing YouTube livestream documenting the making of the mixtape, naturally integrating Pierre Paulin's design into the visual identity of the music project.Originally designed by Pierre Paulin in 1970, the Dune system reimagined traditional furniture as an adaptable, borderless landscape rather than a set of fixed objects. Unproduced during the designer’s lifetime, the piece is now faithfully brought to life by Paulin, Paulin, Paulin in highly limited editions. By integrating the design into the artists' Mexico studio retreat, the design house continues its ongoing dialogue with contemporary culture and modern artistic expression. items.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Surpasses 'Avengers: Endgame' for Largest Domestic Opening in History
items.text: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Surpasses 'Avengers: Endgame' for Largest Domestic Opening in History Summary 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' reached $360 million USD in its domestic debut to surpass 'Avengers: Endgame'The film stands as the largest domestic opening weekend in box office history while generating $932 million USD globallyDirected by Destin Daniel Cretton the fourth installment leads the all-time North American box office rankings Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios have officially dethroned Avengers: Endgame as Spider-Man: Brand New Day achieved a record-shattering $360 million USD domestic debut. The final opening weekend total surpassed Sunday's estimates of $355 million USD to eclipse the previous benchmark of $357 million USD set in 2019.The Tom Holland-led feature kicked off its theatrical run with a record $72 million USD in preview screenings before delivering a $169.8 million USD opening day. Worldwide, the film generated $932 million USD—marking the second-largest global launch of all time, behind only Avengers: Endgame ($1.2 billion USD). Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton (Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings), the story picks up after Spider-Man: No Way Home, following Peter Parker as he fights crime in New York City amidst mutating powers and a world that no longer remembers his identity.Celebrating the historic milestone, Sony Pictures chairman Tom Rothman extended gratitude to the filmmakers, cast, and distribution teams behind the release. With this latest achievement, Marvel Studios titles now hold the top four domestic theatrical openings in history, led by Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($360 million USD), Avengers: Endgame ($357 million USD), Spider-Man: No Way Home ($260 million USD), and Avengers: Infinity War ($257 million USD).Spider-Man: Brand New Day is currently playing in theaters globally. items.title: Porsche Returns to the Waves for New Duotone Kiteboarding Collection
items.text: Porsche Returns to the Waves for New Duotone Kiteboarding Collection In its ongoing partnership with Duotone, Porsche has paid homage to some of its most visually exciting and mechanically innovative vehicles through the world of watersport gear. With its previous “Pink Pig” set turning out to be a must-have among fans, the brand now unveils a new collection based on the Cayenne Turbo Electric. As one of the leading electric vehicles on the market, the SUV model is reimagined in a series of highly technical Duotone kiteboarding goods that match its dynamic quality. One of the products that particularly emulates the essence of the car is the new Evo SLS kite. In an exclusive pre-release of the 2027 model, the new special edition version shares a feel for its forward-thinking engineering that enables performance on the water. From the new kite, bar, and kitebag to the Jaime SLS board with a Big Air Handle and an electric pump, the collection continues to hone in on the Cayenne Turbo Electric’s design through several sleek features. On the kite, the car brand’s logo is layered onto the vehicle’s “Mystic Green Metallic” color while the curves of the grill appear on the top edge. For the board, Porsche branding is presented in its signature red hue along the bottom center, while the top features a “Mystic Green” finish enhanced with distinctive Porsche design details.Items in the collection come in various sizes and drop in a limited run of 1,156 pieces across all individual components to honor the Cayenne Turbo Electric’s impressive peak power output.Take a closer look at the drop in the gallery now. You can now shop the Porsche x Duotone collection online and at select retailers worldwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Macau Nights, Continental Heights: Inside Asia’s 50 Best Bars 2026
items.text: Macau Nights, Continental Heights: Inside Asia’s 50 Best Bars 2026 If 2026 has proved anything, it’s that cocktail culture is becoming far more intentional. As drinking habits shift and casual nightlife slows down, the high-end cocktail scene is elevating to meet a crowd that values depth over simple night-outs. After kicking off the year’s celebratory series in North America and following up with Europe’s historic debut in Amsterdam, the celebration made its third and final regional pitstop in Macau. Returning for its second year in this dedicated regional showcase, Asia’s 50 Best Bars gathered the continent’s premier mixology heavyweights at Wynn Palace in Macau. Hypemaps was on the ground with Cointreau, gaining behind-the-scenes access to a night that felt like a high-stakes spectacle and a tight-knit family reunion.As the Official Orange Liqueur Partner of The World's 50 Best Bars, Cointreau served as a focal point throughout the evening, sponsoring the signature ceremonial red scarves worn by all top 50 nominees. Representing Cointreau behind the bar, Kai Ng of Hong Kong’s Quinary showcased the brand's latest spirit, the Cointreau Spicy. Riffing on the beloved spicy margarita template, he paired the new spirit with tequila, clarified grapefruit, jalapeño syrup, and fig leaf soda. Because the spirit is actually infused with Bird’s Eye chili and Jalapeño, it surprisingly delivered a subtle, warming finish instead of upfront heat. The perfect kick to start off the night.When the live countdown commenced, the tension in the room was palpable. But as each placement rolled out, the competitive edge quickly dissolved into genuine applause, with the entire room erupting in roars for every city represented.When the top spots were finally unveiled, the results made regional history. Taking the No. 1 spot as The Best Bar in Asia 2026 was Guangzhou’s Hope & Sesame, marking a historic milestone as the first venue from Mainland China to claim the top spot. Seoul’s Zest followed closely at No. 2, maintaining its top-tier standing with its forward-thinking, zero-waste mixology. Rounding out the podium at No. 3 was Hong Kong’s Bar Leone, which was last year’s overall winner. Proving that unpretentious, classic Italian cocktail culture still holds an endless appeal across the region.The crowning moment belonged to Hope & Sesame co-founder Andrew Ho, who took the stage after a decade of quiet, relentless hustling behind a hidden speakeasy door in Guangzhou. items.title: Lollapalooza Leveled Up for 2026: Everything We Loved About the Festival This Year
items.text: Lollapalooza Leveled Up for 2026: Everything We Loved About the Festival This Year Festival season is coming to a close, with Lollapalooza one of the seasonal indicators of the final drag of the dog days. The four-day Chicago fest goes down in late-July/early-August every year, taking over Grant Park for one of North America's most anticipated annual music events. Right in line with April's Coachella and June's Bonnaroo, Lolla stands out in that it's one of the only festivals to still stretch four full days. However, Lollapalooza's 2026 iteration saw the Chi-town fest offer up one of its most impressive years, giving Coachella a real run for its money.For starters, this year's curation of talent was a four-day force to be reckoned with. Headlined by the Mount Rushmore of Pop Girlies – Lorde, Charli XCX, Olivia Dean, JENNIE, and Tate McRae – the leaders of the lineup all graced Grant Park at particularly important times.Fresh off her first post-brat release, Charli XCX arrived in Chi-town ready to live debut new album Music Fashion Film. For Lorde, this marks her first-ever time headlining the coveted festival, after her set got cancelled due to weather after four songs when she first played Lolla 12 years ago. On the heels of one of the most impressive banner years, Olivia Dean's Lolla headlining set signals her first-ever headlining slot at a US festival. JENNIE and Tate McRae are both deep in album rollout mode, with all eyes on the K-pop star as she made history on the stage as the first solo K-POP headlining act, and Canada's pop princess as she continues to not-so-subtly tease her new project. Other notable pop names included Slayyyter, MUNA, Zara Larsson, ADÉLA, and beabadoobee.Lil Uzi Vert – before their set was canned – was a good get, too, the rapper gearing up for some sort of longform release. Little Simz was another we were especially excited about, the UK rapper actually ending up running a last-minute surprise DJ set at Hacienda PATRÓN; the rare, intimate set in the middle of Grant Park is closest many will ever get to Simz. Dev Hynes made a stop in Chi for Lolla amid his busy summer run of shows, while Leon Thomas slid through on his birthday (and brought Babychiefdoit).Along with the A-listers, emerging talent from across the globe are also platformed both on and off the official lineup. New York five-man-unit WHATMORE brought its undeniable NYC ethos to the Midwest, while Love Spells, Wolf Alice, Ecca Vandal all nabbed spots on the calenda

items.title: David Harbour and Kristen Bell Team up in Official 'Violent Night 2' Trailer
items.text: David Harbour and Kristen Bell Team up in Official 'Violent Night 2' Trailer Summary The official trailer for Tommy Wirkola's 'Violent Night 2' has dropped featuring David Harbour returning as Santa ClausThe action-packed sequel sees a depowered Santa team up with Mrs Claus played by Kristen Bell to fight a ruthless gangsterProduced with action design from 87North the film hits theaters worldwide on December 4, 2026 Director Tommy Wirkola and action production house 87North have officially debuted the official trailer for Violent Night 2. The upcoming holiday action sequel sees David Harbour reprise his role as Santa Claus alongside newcomer Kristen Bell as Mrs. Claus.The Universal Pictures holiday thriller sequel picks up four years after the events of the 2022 original, the sequel finds Saint Nick stripped of his festive magic and trapped inside the Silver Bell Mall. When a ruthless gangster, played by Jared Harris, takes the mall merchants hostage, Santa must rediscover his seasonal spirit while relying on raw combat to save the day. Reinforcements arrive in the form of Mrs. Claus (Bell), who enters the fray armed with katanas and hammers.Action design for the sequel is once again spearheaded by 87North, featuring brutal set pieces with improvised weaponry including flame-tipped arrows, floor pianos, and cookie cutters. Written by returning screenwriters Pat Casey and Josh Miller, the feature pairs signature action design with a wide ensemble cast. Joining Harbour, Harris, and Bell are screen legend Joe Pantoliano, Daniela Melchior, Andrew Bachelor, and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman.Violent Night 2 releases exclusively in theaters on December 4. items.title: A LEGO Ideas Builder Recasts Michelangelo's ‘David’ as a Brick-Built Marble Bust
items.text: A LEGO Ideas Builder Recasts Michelangelo's ‘David’ as a Brick-Built Marble Bust Summary A LEGO Ideas submission reimagines Michelangelo's David as a classical bust built entirely from LEGO bricksThe all-white design captures David's head, shoulders, and upper chest, with the hair curls cited as the toughest element to constructThe concept leans into the contrast between smooth marble and geometric brick, keeping the construction visible up close A LEGO Ideas creator has recreated Michelangelo's David in LEGO bricks, translating one of sculpture's most recognizable figures into a monochrome, brick-built bust. Rather than smoothing the source into an imitation of stone, the concept treats the blocky language of LEGO as a feature, offering a portrait that reads as marble from afar and as unmistakable brickwork from up close.The build narrows the full statue down to a classical bust, capturing David's head, neck, shoulders, and upper chest. The design concentrates on the details that carry the figure's identity, the intense eyes, strong nose, slightly parted lips, and powerful jawline, along with the anatomical tension running through the neck and shoulders. By the creator's account, the hair posed the biggest challenge, with each curl shaped to add depth, rhythm, and movement to the overall silhouette.At the heart of the concept is a deliberate clash of materials. Marble reads as smooth, continuous, and organic, while LEGO is defined by hard geometric edges, and instead of disguising that tension, the design makes it the point. The seams and structure of the bricks are left visible so the construction becomes part of the sculptural effect, resolving into a complete likeness at a distance while staying openly modular in the hand.Color is stripped out entirely to reinforce the reference. The monochrome white palette nods to both carved marble and the plaster casts long used in museums and art studios, and with no color to lean on, the facial structure, curls, and anatomy are defined purely through light and shadow. A classical pedestal rounds out the composition, lending the piece the presence of a museum display.The concept also plugs into a broader story about how these builds reach shelves. Michelangelo carved the original David from marble in the early 1500s, and it has stood among the defining works of Renaissance sculpture ever since. items.title: Charli XCX's ‘Music, Fashion, Film’ Debuts at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 for Her Biggest Opening Yet
items.text: Charli XCX's ‘Music, Fashion, Film’ Debuts at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 for Her Biggest Opening Yet Summary Charli XCX's eighth studio album Music, Fashion, Film debuts at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, the largest opening week of her careerThe set marks her fourth career top 10 and second of 2026, making her the only woman to log two top-10 debuts this yearMorgan Wallen's I'm the Problem returns to No. 1 for a 14th nonconsecutive week atop the same chart Charli XCX's Music, Fashion, Film debuts at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, handing the pop star the largest opening week of her career and her fourth top 10 among all-genre album charts. The set arrives on the August 8-dated chart with 78,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the tracking week ending July 30, according to Luminate.Physical demand drove the debut. Album sales accounted for 57,000 of that 78,000 total, the best sales week of Charli XCX's career and enough to open at No. 1 on Top Album Sales, her first leader on that list. Streaming equivalent album units contributed 21,000, translating to 21.74 million on-demand official streams and a No. 23 debut on Top Streaming Albums, with track equivalent albums adding a negligible amount. The project was released across a wide spread of formats, including 15 vinyl variants (three of them signed), four CD editions (two signed), four digital downloads (one carrying three extra B-sides), and a single cassette.The debut also carries a record. With Music, Fashion, Film, Charli XCX becomes the only woman, and just the third act overall, to notch at least two top-10 debuts in 2026, joining Drake, who logged three simultaneous entries in May with ICEMAN, HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR, and ATEEZ, who scored two with GOLDEN HOUR: Part.4 and Part.5. It is her second top 10 of the year, following the Wuthering Heights soundtrack that debuted and peaked at No. 8 in February. Announced on June 1, the album landed July 24 on the back of its Hot 100-charting single "Rock Music."Atop the chart, Morgan Wallen's I'm the Problem returns to No. 1 for a 14th nonconsecutive week, stepping 3-1 with 80,000 equivalent album units, its first week on top since January. The album, which has never left the top 10 since debuting more than a year ago, is likely benefiting from attention around Wallen's standalone single "Been by Now" and his Still the Problem stadium tour, which wrapped August 1 in Philadelphia. items.title: Helinox and WE11DONE Twist Camping-Chair Tension Into a Dart-Draped Capsule
items.text: Helinox and WE11DONE Twist Camping-Chair Tension Into a Dart-Draped Capsule Summary WE11DONE and Helinox have created their first collaborative capsule, pairing jersey T-shirts with a camping chairThe apparel borrows from the panel structure and tension of camping furniture, rendered through sculptural dart detailingWE11DONE's signature metal piercing hardware runs across both the clothing and the chair in a black and charcoal palette WE11DONE and Helinox have joined for a first-time capsule collection that treats camping gear as a design blueprint rather than a backdrop. The Seoul label builds the range around jersey T-shirts and a camping chair, pulling the structural logic of outdoor furniture directly into the cut of the clothing.The construction is where the two worlds meet. WE11DONE took inspiration from the panel layout and tension of camping furniture, then translated that into dart detailing that gives the fabric a three-dimensional, twisted-and-pulled drape. The effect turns a technical structural idea into a sculptural garment shape, so the tees carry a built-in sense of pull rather than hanging flat.Running through the collection is the brand's signature metal piercing detail, applied across the pieces to tie the apparel to its outdoor counterpart. That same hardware appears on the camping chair itself, which extends the design vocabulary from the body onto the furniture and lets the chair read as part of the collection rather than a separate accessory. The result is a set of objects meant to work in the city and in nature alike.The palette keeps everything deliberately restrained. The capsule is built in black and charcoal, and the jersey T-shirts and camping chair are framed as camping essentials, a tight edit rather than a broad seasonal spread. The tension between the loose, sculptural drape and the cold metal hardware is the defining note, a contrast that gives the small lineup its distinct character.The Helinox x WE11DONE capsule collection is available now through the WE11DONE official online store and the brand's Cheongdam flagship store. items.title: thisisneverthat and fragment design Unite for the First Time on a "neverenough" Capsule
items.text: thisisneverthat and fragment design Unite for the First Time on a "neverenough" Capsule Summary thisisneverthat and fragment design have joined forces for their first-ever collaboration, a compact capsule of fleece and jersey staplesThe collection centers on a newly developed "neverenough" graphic that merges the two brands' identitiesEvery piece carries fragment design's signature double lightning-bolt emblem thisisneverthat and fragment design have come together for the first time, unveiling a capsule collection anchored by a purpose-built "neverenough" graphic. The Seoul label and Hiroshi Fujiwara's studio keep the range tight and graphic-led, letting a shared motif and one instantly recognizable logo carry the whole project.The lineup is deliberately focused. Three styles make up the capsule, a hoodie, a crewneck sweatshirt, and a T-shirt, a fleece-and-jersey core that reads as everyday wardrobe rather than a sprawling seasonal push. Keeping the count low puts the emphasis squarely on the graphics, which is where a collaboration like this earns its keep.The central motif is the "neverenough" graphic, a design created specifically for this team-up that blends the two brands' visual languages into a single mark. Layered over that is the piece both parties are best known by on Fujiwara's side: fragment design's double lightning bolt appears across the items, giving the capsule the unmistakable stamp that tends to define anything the studio touches.The pairing carries weight because of who is involved. thisisneverthat, launched in Seoul in 2010, has grown into one of the most recognized names in Asian streetwear, with a following built on its graphic sensibility. fragment design, led by the figure often called the godfather of streetwear, brings a track record in which collaborations routinely sell out on arrival. A first meeting between the two lands as a genuine event rather than a routine capsule.The thisisneverthat x fragment design capsule releases in Japan on August 7 through thisisneverthat's directly operated stores and online store. items.title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and Mitsukoshi Seisakusho Reimagine a 1937 "Bamboo Chair" in Lacquer Black
items.text: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and Mitsukoshi Seisakusho Reimagine a 1937 "Bamboo Chair" in Lacquer Black Summary WILDSIDE, the conceptual project from Yohji Yamamoto, has partnered with furniture atelier Mitsukoshi Seisakusho for the first time on a blacked-out edition of the historic "Bamboo Chair"The piece renders a 1937 design in a deep lacquer-like black, with the WILDSIDE logo laser-engraved into the backrest in a subtle matte finishEach chair is fully made to order and handbuilt by a single Mitsukoshi Seisakusho craftsman WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto has joined forces with Mitsukoshi Seisakusho for its first collaboration with the storied maker, producing a jet-black interpretation of the "Bamboo Chair." The project takes a piece of mid-century Japanese design history and refinishes it in the black that defines WILDSIDE's world, arriving as a made-to-order object built entirely by hand.The chair leads with material. Bamboo's natural give, its curved lines, and the fine detail of its weave carry the form, qualities that have long drawn admiration from furniture designers working in the modern idiom. Here those elements meet WILDSIDE's signature black, producing a version of the chair with a depth recalling the black of traditional Japanese lacquerware and architecture. The finish does more than color the surface; it sharpens the material's texture and throws the contours and structure into relief, giving the supple curves a more sculptural, arresting presence.The branding is deliberately quiet. On the reverse of the glossy, lacquer-like body, the WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO logo is laser-engraved, then finished in a subdued matte so it surfaces only as the light shifts across it. It is a restrained touch that lets the object's silhouette do the talking, and it reinforces that this is a built-to-order piece rather than a mass product; every chair is made one at a time by a Mitsukoshi Seisakusho artisan.The heritage behind the form is a large part of the appeal. The Bamboo Chair was designed in 1937 by Umonji Kidokoro, then working in the Mitsukoshi furniture design studio, the operation that would become Mitsukoshi Seisakusho. Kidokoro's work is said to have influenced French designer Charlotte Perriand, and he traveled Japan's craft regions alongside figures including Sori Yanagi and Junzo Sakakura, even presenting a bamboo chaise longue. items.title: XINADÜ's "ECHO" Capsule Translates the Earth's Deep Memory Into Outdoor Gear
items.text: XINADÜ's "ECHO" Capsule Translates the Earth's Deep Memory Into Outdoor Gear Summary XINADÜ, the brand founded by Xin Liu in 2025, is launching "ECHO," its first outdoor capsule collectionThe range is conceived as a design experiment in "temporal-spatial overlay," drawing on natural processes to shape its visuals and constructionCore pieces span sun-protective apparel, shell jackets, down jackets, denim, and functional accessories built for both city and wilderness XINADÜ has unveiled "ECHO," an outdoor capsule collection that frames technical apparel as a record of the planet's deep history. Founded by Xin Liu in 2025, the street-lifestyle label builds the range around an "exploratory wardrobe" concept, delivering a trans-seasonal, multi-scenario lineup meant to move between everyday urban wear and full outdoor expeditions.The concept driving the capsule is an ambitious one. XINADÜ presents "ECHO" as a study in what it calls temporal-spatial overlay, a chronological scroll that records the Earth's long memory. The brand looks to the traces left by natural evolution and converts processes like sedimentation, flow, fracture, and reconstruction into a design vocabulary, positioning each garment as a vessel for the present while its visuals read as echoes from primeval worlds. It is a framing that casts the wearer as someone passing through landscapes shaped by countless shifts of life, terrain, and civilization.That conceptual weight is grounded in a functional, wearable roster. The collection centers on core pieces that include sun-protective apparel, shell jackets, down jackets, denim items, and functional accessories, a spread designed to cover shifting needs from daily city dressing to demanding outdoor conditions. By combining varied materials, structures, and performance properties, the range aims to stay adaptable across seasons and settings rather than locking into a single use case.The result is a deliberate meeting of protection and attitude. Professional protective construction is merged with street-oriented silhouettes, so the garments are built to respond to the environment while still serving as a medium for personal expression. That balance reflects XINADÜ's wider identity, a brand that threads music through its spirit and draws on ethnic culture as a source, then fuses those traditional symbols with futuristic visuals and street aesthetics to arrive at a recognizable lifestyle statement.The XINADÜ "ECHO" collection will be released sequential

items.title: UFC Lost $30 Million USD From White House Event
items.text: UFC Lost $30 Million USD From White House Event Summary TKO Group revealed that the UFC incurred an approximate $30 million USD loss on its UFC Freedom 250 White House eventElevated operational costs and zero ticket sales directly impacted company margins despite record streaming numbersDriven by strong overall Q2 performance TKO Group raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance by $75 million USD TKO Group and the UFC suffered an approximate $30 million USD financial loss on the UFC Freedom 250 event held on the White House grounds on June 14. Following TKO's Q2 2026 earnings call, executive chairman and CEO Ari Emanuel framed the high-profile spectacle as a major success for brand exposure despite the heavy operational expenses.During the earnings call, TKO CFO Andrew Schleimer clarified that the company incurred significantly higher-than-normal costs to stage the event on the White House grounds, which coincided with President Donald Trump's 80th birthday. Because tickets were not sold to the public, the organization recorded zero live event ticket revenue to offset production costs, weighing heavily on UFC and consolidated company margins for the quarter.Despite the financial hit, the seven-fight card achieved massive viewership, averaging 8.2 million viewers across the U.S. and Latin America on Paramount+ to mark the service's largest live exclusive stream to date. Total global viewership exceeded 34 million, while the accompanying two-day Fan Fest attracted over 130,000 visitors. TKO management emphasized that the event provided strategic access to corporate partners, leading to multi-year sponsorship agreements extending through 2028. Powered by strong overall Q2 metrics across both UFC and WWE, TKO raised its full-year 2026 revenue projection by $75 million USD to a range between $5.775 billion USD and $5.825 billion USD. items.title: Serena and Venus Williams Return to the Doubles Court at the 2026 Cincinnati Open
items.text: Serena and Venus Williams Return to the Doubles Court at the 2026 Cincinnati Open Summary Serena and Venus Williams have been awarded a doubles wildcard for the 2026 Cincinnati Open, marking their first appearance as a team since the 2022 US OpenThe announcement follows Serena's return to professional tennis at Wimbledon in July, where a knee injury forced the sisters to withdraw from their scheduled doubles reunionIn addition to their doubles entry, 46-year-old Venus Williams received a singles wildcard for the tournament ahead of the US Open in late August Serena Williams and Venus Williams are preparing to reunite on the doubles court after receiving a wildcard entry for the Cincinnati Open. The legendary duo last competed as a team at the 2022 US Open, where they fell to Czech players Lucie Hradecka and Linda Noskova. Playing together in the Ohio hard-court tournament marks the first time the sisters will take the court as a doubles pairing at this specific event. The highly anticipated return arrives just weeks before the final Grand Slam of the year begins in New York on August 31.The Cincinnati comeback follows a scrapped reunion earlier this summer. Both sisters were slated to play doubles at Wimbledon last month but were forced to withdraw from the draw after 44-year-old Serena suffered a knee injury. The physical setback also impacted her singles campaign, which ended in a first-round loss to Australian prospect Maya Joint. Tournament organizers confirmed that Venus will also compete in the Cincinnati singles draw. The 46-year-old boasts a 12-10 career record at the venue and previously reached the semifinals in 2012.Adding the Williams sisters to the field injects undeniable star power into the summer schedule. Together the pair has captured 14 Grand Slam doubles titles and three Olympic gold medals. The upcoming appearance serves as a critical tune-up for both athletes. Beyond the sibling reunion in Ohio, Venus is already scheduled to play mixed doubles alongside Alexander Bublik at the US Open. Main draw action for the Cincinnati Open is slated to begin on August 11. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Winamp Is Coming Back in 2027 Through a New Strategic Partnership With Deezer
items.text: Winamp Is Coming Back in 2027 Through a New Strategic Partnership With Deezer Summary Deezer will power Winamp's new premium subscription service using its white-label technology and extensive music libraryThe next-generation Winamp Player is scheduled for release in the first half of 2027The platform aims to blend modern streaming with support for local MP3 libraries and internet radio Iconic media player Winamp is set to relaunch in the first half of 2027 through a strategic partnership with music streaming service Deezer. The revamped application will integrate Deezer’s white-label streaming technology and its massive catalog of over 100 million tracks into a new premium subscription offering. This ambitious move brings a beloved desktop staple from the late 1990s back to the forefront of digital culture under the classic Winamp brand.The upcoming software promises to seamlessly blend premium audio streaming with user-owned local files. Listeners can expect a highly customizable interface that supports personal cloud-based collections, internet radio stations and podcasts. Bridging the gap between retro local playback and contemporary streaming allows the company to challenge the traditional listening experience. Existing fans of the classic Winamp desktop player will also gain access to the new service once the platform officially drops.Competing against established industry heavyweights presents a steep uphill battle for the legacy application. Spotify and Apple Music currently dominate the digital audio landscape with massively entrenched user bases. Winamp intends to carve out a distinct niche by appealing to nostalgic users who still curate vast collections of ripped MP3s from the early 2000s. Delivering a fundamentally different subscription model could attract audiophiles looking for bespoke organization and unique social discovery features.Winamp Group executives emphasize a deep desire to give users total freedom over how they consume digital media. The Deezer collaboration goes beyond basic technology licensing to create an entirely fresh product experience tailored for the modern streaming era. While official pricing details remain unannounced, the year-long development cycle will likely reveal more about modernized creator tools and iconic visualizer effects. Enthusiasts can anticipate additional product previews in the coming months as the legendary player prepares its cultural resurgence. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: F1 Delays 2027 Calendar Announcement as Middle East Conflict Forces Major Schedule Restructuring
items.text: F1 Delays 2027 Calendar Announcement as Middle East Conflict Forces Major Schedule Restructuring Summary Formula 1 President Stefano Domenicali confirmed the official 2027 F1 calendar announcement has been delayed until autumn 2026 to accommodate geopolitical contingency planningThe series intends to maintain a robust 24-race schedule for next year despite ongoing conflict in the Middle East forcing the cancellation of the 2026 Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands PrixFuture schedule adjustments include confirmed returns to Turkey and Portugal alongside active negotiations for potential races in Rwanda, Argentina and Germany Formula 1 is actively restructuring its global footprint as geopolitical realities disrupt the traditional motorsport schedule. Formula 1 President Stefano Domenicali recently confirmed that the official announcement for the 2027 F1 calendar will be delayed until the autumn of 2026. This tactical pause allows the championship to finalize robust contingency plans amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. While the sport usually locks in its following year well in advance, the current climate requires dynamic flexibility. The ongoing crisis has already heavily impacted the current season by forcing the cancellation of the 2026 Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix. Organizers acknowledge the possibility of the season ending early in Europe if the Qatar and Abu Dhabi events are also deemed unviable.Despite these massive logistical hurdles, the premier racing series remains committed to delivering a full 24-race slate for the upcoming year. To bridge the immediate gap, executives have already pivoted by adding Malaysia to the 2026 rotation as a direct replacement for the postponed Bahrain event. Domenicali emphasized that a primary plan is currently being drafted with the expectation of starting in the Middle East, but backup options are firmly in place. This agility highlights a critical shift in how global sporting entities must operate to ensure that logistics, broadcasting and team development timelines remain uninterrupted when major host regions face severe instability.Looking ahead to the 2027 schedule, the European leg is set for a noticeable shakeup. Formula 1 has officially announced that both Turkey and Portugal will return to the grid. items.title: Toyota Is Reportedly Developing a Targa-Top Variant of the Upcoming GR GT Supercar
items.text: Toyota Is Reportedly Developing a Targa-Top Variant of the Upcoming GR GT Supercar Summary Toyota is reportedly developing a targa-top version of the upcoming GR GT, potentially reviving the Aero Top moniker used on the fourth-generation SupraThe Japanese automaker is also rumored to be preparing a higher-performance track-focused variant equipped with aggressive aerodynamic enhancementsWhile the base supercar is expected to feature an all-aluminum frame and a 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 hybrid powertrain, official announcements for these new variants may not arrive until 2027 Toyota may be expanding its future performance flagship lineup with a targa-top variant of the highly anticipated GR GT. According to a new report from the Japanese publication Magazine X, an open-roof model is currently in development alongside the standard coupe. The variant would allegedly utilize a removable roof panel to serve as a spiritual successor to the iconic A80 Supra Aero Top from the 1990s. While the news remains unconfirmed by the brand itself, introducing a pop-top option allows Toyota to compete directly with exotic open-top rivals in the premium supercar segment.Beyond the targa configuration, the report suggests a more extreme tuned version of the GR GT is also in the works. Industry speculation points toward a track-focused GRMN model incorporating advanced aerodynamic components previously seen on recent GT3 race car development mules. Japanese sources indicate the core vehicle will boast an all-aluminum frame paired with a front-mounted 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 and a rear transaxle housing a hybrid electric motor. This advanced powertrain setup is projected to produce system outputs exceeding 640 horsepower and massive torque figures.The production strategy for the GR GT is expected to mirror the extreme exclusivity of the legendary Lexus LFA. Rumors suggest Toyota plans to manufacture only around 500 units globally and keep the price tag under the 30 million yen mark. Sales will reportedly be conducted directly through the Gazoo Racing division rather than standard dealer networks. Prospective buyers might even face a strict vetting process or interview with company representatives to secure an allocation. Enthusiasts eager to see the specialized Aero Top and GRMN editions will need significant patience, as official announcements for the derivative models are not predicted until 2027 or later. items.title: Brock Lesnar Announces His Retirement From Professional Wrestling Following SummerSlam Trilogy Finale
items.text: Brock Lesnar Announces His Retirement From Professional Wrestling Following SummerSlam Trilogy Finale Summary Announced his official retirement from professional wrestling and combat sports during an appearance on The Pat McAfee ShowConcluded a 25-year career following a definitive loss to Oba Femi in a Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam in his home city of MinneapolisConfirmed that the emotional weekend solidified his decision to step away despite a previous retirement tease at WrestleMania 42 Eleven-time world champion Brock Lesnar has officially retired. The 49-year-old combat sports veteran stated he is entirely done with the squared circle and all other forms of competition. The definitive announcement arrived on The Pat McAfee Show on August 4, 2026. The declaration followed a headlining trilogy-ending clash at SummerSlam against Oba Femi. During the aftermath of their Hell in a Cell bout in his billed home city of Minneapolis, Lesnar anointed the rising star as the future of the industry while acknowledging himself as the past.Fans initially expected a departure back in April. Lesnar laid his gloves down in the ring after taking a loss to Femi at WrestleMania 42. He ultimately returned a month later to secure a victory at Clash in Italy. That sequence set the stage for their climactic third encounter. Lesnar admitted that while he felt he had fuel in the tank following the WrestleMania bout, the grueling Saturday match in Minneapolis marked the true end of his journey.Lesnar leaves behind a monumental legacy as one of the most dominant forces in modern combat sports history. He debuted on the main roster more than a quarter century ago. The former University of Minnesota standout quickly conquered professional wrestling before transitioning to mixed martial arts. He captured the UFC heavyweight championship in just his fourth professional fight. His second run with WWE added a grizzled dimension to his character. He famously ended The Undertaker's undefeated WrestleMania streak and stacked up multiple heavyweight titles across different global organizations. The veteran also won the King of the Ring tournament in 2002 and claimed two Royal Rumble victories over his expansive career.The final years of his career were heavily shadowed by legal controversy. items.title: SB19 Makes the Case That Pinoy Pop Belongs on Every Global Stage
items.text: SB19 Makes the Case That Pinoy Pop Belongs on Every Global Stage SB19 is the first Filipino and Southeast Asian act ever booked on a Lollapalooza bill, and for a lot of the American crowd, their set will be a first brush with Pinoy pop (P-pop) entirely. The group knows what that means. "First, it's an honor to represent the Philippines and Southeast Asia on a stage like Lollapalooza. At the same time, there's pressure because we're introducing P-pop to people who may be hearing it for the first time," they tell Hypebeast.Rather than shying away from the pressure, the group instead chose to lean on the work. "We approached the set with excellence and confidence, believing we were chosen because we have a story to tell through our music and who we are as artists," they shared. More than the performance itself, they want the crowd to clock who they are and where they come from. "We hope people walk away seeing us as artists first. We write our music, perform it live, and most importantly, we hope they see the Philippines through us as a country full of talent, great stories, and world-class artistry. Being the first is a statement that Filipino music belongs on the global stage."The festival caps a run that's come together quickly — a GRAMMY Museum moment, a Billboard Music Awards nomination, a Philippine Arena sellout — but none of those milestones have changed how they see the group. "For us, we're always focused on becoming better and preparing for what's next. These milestones remind us to keep training, keep improving, and stay true to who we are throughout the journey," they revealed. The point, for them, is to stay level. "It's important for us to stay grounded and present while continuing to push ourselves toward the level of excellence and caliber we want to achieve as a group."Meanwhile, their latest single "LAWLESS" lands at the peak of this breakout stretch. The track runs heavy on outlaw energy and deliberately moves between English and Tagalog without slowing down. "For us, it's important to introduce who we are as Filipinos and share our story with the world. Incorporating our own language creates a connection point that allows people to experience where we come from, while the energy of 'LAWLESS' represents our readiness for the global stage," they proudly say. "The song carries the message that nothing can stop us from pursuing what we believe in. We chose 'LAWLESS' because this moment represents who we are now: braver, more mature, and more

items.title: Christie's New York to Auction Costumes From 'The Devil Wears Prada 2'
items.text: Christie's New York to Auction Costumes From 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' Summary Christie’s will host an online auction featuring original wardrobes and accessories from 'The Devil Wears Prada 2'Proceeds from the sale will benefit the Committee to Protect Journalists and the Council of Fashion Designers of AmericaA public exhibition of the auction items will run from September 8 through September 13 at Christie’s New York Christie’s and 20th Century Studios have announced an online auction showcasing original wardrobes and accessories from the upcoming film The Devil Wears Prada 2. Spearheaded in collaboration with star Meryl Streep, the bidding event takes place online from September 1 to September 15, 2026, with proceeds benefiting the Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) and the Council of Fashion Designers of America (CFDA).The auction features high-fashion garments and luxury accessories worn on screen by cast members Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci, Simone Ashley, and Lady Gaga. Highlights from the sale include a signed prototype pair of red Valentino Garavani Rockstud pumps worn by Streep’s character Miranda Priestly, alongside a Fall/Winter 2025 Dries Van Noten tassel coat and a black and white Schiaparelli jacket.Additional key lots include a Gabriela Hearst Niki dress screen-worn by Anne Hathaway, an Elsa Peretti Bone Cuff worn by Emily Blunt, and a Bad Binch TongTong by Terrence Zhou feathered maxi dress worn by Lady Gaga in the RUNWAY music video. The catalog also offers pieces from Dolce & Gabbana, Dior, Elie Saab, Vhernier, Fendi, and a classic J.Crew cerulean sweater.The online auction for The Devil Wears Prada 2 collection runs from September 1 to September 15, 2026, exclusively online, with a free public exhibition taking place at Christie’s New York from September 8 to September 13. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: New Balance Drops the Neon-Accented “Night Lights Pack”
items.text: New Balance Drops the Neon-Accented “Night Lights Pack” Name: New Balance “Night Lights Pack”MSRP: ¥15,400 - ¥24,200 JPY (approx. $98 - $153 USD)Release Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: New BalanceNew Balance's “Night Lights Pack” introduces a dynamic four-piece collection available exclusively through the brand's official channels. Inspired by the striking visual of city lights piercing through the dark, the overarching aesthetic of the capsule pairs understated grey and black bases with vibrant blue and neon yellow accents. This limited-edition release seamlessly bridges the gap between retro-futuristic lifestyle silhouettes and modern performance running technology, delivering a cohesive, luminescent narrative across four distinct models: the 9060R, ABZORB 2000, 740 and the FuelCell Rebel v5.Anchoring the lifestyle offerings, the 9060R arrives in a “Sea Salt with Fresh Air and Slate Grey” colorway, keeping things relatively light with a mostly grey suede and open saddle mesh upper that is elevated by an extended mudguard and debossed print details. Transitioning into a more covert aesthetic, the ABZORB 2000 embraces a stealthy profile clad in black mesh and blue synthetics, heavily highlighted by striking hits of neon glow that accentuate its aggressive, Y2K-inspired paneling. Rounding out the retro-runner trio is the 740, which stands as the darkest silhouette in the pack; it features a deeply structured black upper and grey mesh base sharply interrupted by subtle, glowing neon splashes that emphasize its technical overlays.The collection is completed by the performance-driven FuelCell Rebel v5, presented in a vibrant “Fresh Air with Zinc Blue” colorway that serves as a sleek contrast to its darker counterparts. Designed to look and feel fast, this everyday trainer features a streamlined, race-inspired engineered mesh upper bonded with ultra-light FantomFit technology for breathable support. The design is grounded by a bold midsole geometry utilizing an energetic PEBA and EVA FuelCell foam blend, while reflective accents strategically placed across the silhouette enhance nighttime visibility, perfectly capturing the pack's radiant theme. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: A24 Just Dropped the First ‘PRIMETIME’ Trailer, and Robert Pattinson's Chris Hansen Is Unsettling
items.text: A24 Just Dropped the First ‘PRIMETIME’ Trailer, and Robert Pattinson's Chris Hansen Is Unsettling Summary A24 has released the first trailer for Lance Oppenheim’s 'PRIMETIME'The biographical film stars Robert Pattinson as 'To Catch a Predator' host Chris HansenThe movie releases September 25 The first official trailer for A24 and Lance Oppenheim’s PRIMETIME is here. Starring Robert Pattinson as To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen, the biographical film is inspired by true events that follows the origins of the popular Dateline NBC series.The dark trailer spotlights Pattinson’s Hansen as To Catch a Predator transforms into a mainstay in American households. Sting operations, teasers of violence, and the involvement of the law are evident across the two-minute video, along with Hansen’s desire to catch a “whale” of a predator that will give the show the recognition it “deserves.” He goes through lengths to make the series as successful as he possibly can, even with several people around him questioning his vigilante-style journalism.Joining Pattinson in the cast are Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Phoebe Bridgers, Matthew Maher, and Bokeem Woodbine. The film is based on Luke Dittrich’s 2007 Esquire article, which details the event of one controversial sting operation.Watch the trailer above. PRIMETIME hits theaters September 25. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Seiko Continues Its 145th Anniversary Celebrations With Six Limited-Edition “Edo Purple” Timepieces
items.text: Seiko Continues Its 145th Anniversary Celebrations With Six Limited-Edition “Edo Purple” Timepieces Summary Seiko celebrates 145 years with Edo purple limited‑edition watches.Six models span Prospex, Astron, Presage, Seiko 5 Sports and Seiko Selection.Available globally in October 2026 in limited runs. To mark its 145th anniversary, Seiko has unveiled a series of limited‑edition watches inspired by “Edo purple,” a traditional Japanese color deeply tied to Tokyo’s cultural heritage. The commemorative collection reflects Seiko’s founding philosophy of being “Always one step ahead of the rest,” blending historical symbolism with modern watchmaking. Each model incorporates purple tones alongside gold accents, representing both Edo’s legacy and Seiko’s enduring commitment to enriching lives with beauty and innovation.The commemorative series spans six distinct models across Seiko's key watch families, each offering a unique interpretation of the heritage colorway. The Prospex line receives two additions: the Prospex Alpinist Mechanical (Ref. HBC006), which reinterprets the 1959 original with a purple dial, wedge-shaped indices, "Alpinist" logotype, and an LWG-certified leather strap limited to 7,000 pieces; and the Prospex Speedtimer Solar Chronograph (Ref. HBJ005), powered by Caliber V192 with a purple-accented dial and tachymeter bezel limited to 8,000 pieces. Meanwhile, the high-tech Seiko Astron GPS Solar Dual-Time Chronograph (Ref. HAB011) features the Caliber 5X83, a purple vertical gradation dial with a horizontal line pattern, a titanium case, and ceramic bracelet center links in a run of 2,000 pieces.Rounding out the collection are three more lifestyle and heritage-driven designs. The Seiko Presage Cocktail Time (Ref. HCB006) takes inspiration from the "Edo Purple" cocktail created by STAR BAR owner Hisashi Kishi, showcasing a translucent purple dial with gold-flake highlights and a GMT hand in a 6,000-piece drop. The Seiko 5 Sports SKX (Ref. HDB003) reinterprets the iconic SKX diver silhouette with a deep purple dial, gold accents, and a glossy Hardlex bezel limited to 9,999 pieces. Last but not least, the Seiko Selection "Rotocall" Digital (Ref. HFL001) recreates the cult-favorite 1982 digital watch with an all-black coated case, gold accents, and an iconic purple rotary function switch limited to 4,000 pieces. All models feature "LIMITED EDITION" caseback engravings and will be available globally starting in October 2026 at Seiko Boutiques and selec

items.title: Awich Headlines Japan's Inaugural Red Bull Symphonic Live Concert Series
items.text: Awich Headlines Japan's Inaugural Red Bull Symphonic Live Concert Series Summary Red Bull Symphonic makes its Japan debut with Awich, Tokyo Secret Orchestra, and conductor Mika Takayama.The four-city tour hits halls in Osaka, Fukuoka, Sendai, and Yokohama in November 2026.Awich’s hip-hop catalog will be reimagined into cinematic orchestral arrangements. Red Bull’s globally acclaimed concert series, Red Bull Symphonic, is making its official Japan debut in November 2026, headlined by Japanese hip-hop queen Awich, alongside the Tokyo Secret Orchestra. Conducting duties will be helmed by Mika Takayama across a four-city tour featuring dates in Osaka, Fukuoka, Sendai and Yokohama.The performance concept goes beyond simply adding orchestral accompaniment. Each song is rebuilt from the ground up, with melodies, rhythms, and harmonies re‑scored to create a cinematic experience that feels both familiar and entirely new. The Tokyo Secret Orchestra, celebrated for its versatility and “Japan quality” sound, will act as a co‑creator rather than a backing ensemble, ensuring the synergy between hip‑hop and classical traditions. Staged in Japan’s most prestigious concert halls, the shows promise to deliver a sweeping, cinematic atmosphere where Awich’s lyrical storytelling meets orchestral grandeur, offering audiences a rare chance to witness her music transformed into a symphonic spectacle.For more information, visit the dedicated webpage for Red Bull Symphonic. items.title: Limited Edt Loads the adidas Originals Superstar With Peacock Motifs and Gold Hardware for a 350-Pair "Made in India" Drop
items.text: Limited Edt Loads the adidas Originals Superstar With Peacock Motifs and Gold Hardware for a 350-Pair "Made in India" Drop Name: Limited Edt x adidas Originals Superstar Consortium “Made in India”Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: ₹11,999 INR/$179 SGD (approx. $125 USD - $140 USD)Release Date: August 8 (India), August 12 (Singapore)Where to Buy: Limited Edtadidas Originals and Limited Edt have unveiled the Superstar Consortium - “Made in India,” a heavily detailed reworking of the shell-toe icon limited to 350 individually numbered pairs worldwide. Released through adidas Originals' Consortium programme, it counts among the first entries to put Indian design at the center of the platform.The design leans on a peacock motif, a nod to India's national bird, that stretches across the upper, the insole and a translucent outsole. Layered over that are intricate vine patterns drawn from traditional textiles, festive embroidery and the ornamental detailing of centuries-old havelis. The Superstar's signature shell toe stays intact, while the finishing hardware does the heavy lifting on luxury: gold lace locks, jewellery-inspired aglets and gold foil branding. Accents of red and blue round out the palette, colors the brand ties to prosperity, purity and celebration.The package around the shoe is where the collectible ambition shows. Every pair arrives in a custom matchbox-inspired box, a reference to the ceremonial lighting of the first flame ahead of an auspicious occasion. Inside, buyers get a custom shoe bag, motif socks, and an alternate set of red and blue laces to swap in against the standard white and black pair, presented in a jewellery pouch. An individually numbered flame charm completes the set and reinforces the one-of-350 positioning.The collaboration carries a clear cultural thesis, one the retailer's founder makes explicit. "This collaboration is about more than a sneaker. It's about showing that Indian culture has a place within global sneaker design. The Superstar is an icon, and this project gave us the opportunity to reinterpret it through an authentically Indian lens while celebrating the craft and culture that continue to inspire us," said Mandeep Chopra, Founder of Limited Edt, in the release.Billed as the first India-origin sneaker collaboration to launch across Limited Edt's India and Singapore markets, the Superstar arrives in a unisex run spanning UK 3 to 13. items.title: Kith &Kin FW26 Elevates Outerwear With Pony Hair and Rope Twill
items.text: Kith &Kin FW26 Elevates Outerwear With Pony Hair and Rope Twill Ronnie Fieg has unveiled the Kith &Kin Fall/Winter 2026 collection. Serving as the brand's first delivery for the second half of the year, the elevated sub-label continues its focus on unbranded simplicity, upscale silhouettes, and premium fabrications. Designed as a study in texture and relaxed tailoring, the new seasonal range seamlessly pairs sophisticated outerwear and intricate pant silhouettes alongside the newly introduced collaborative footwear.Outerwear anchors the collection with textured canvas, painted pony hair leather, striped tropical wool and indigo rope twill denim, each detailed with studded embellishments, bungee adjusters and secure closures. The shirting range expands with pieces like the Melton Polo, Long Sleeve Halston Tee, James Tee and striped poplin Nico Shirt, alongside tropical wool and poplin iterations designed for both upscale and casual wear. Matching sets and loungewear highlight luxe fleece fabrications, including flannel jersey, double-face herringbone, and plush cotton, with standout styles such as the Hiroshi Zip Front Hoodie, Akita Sweatpant, and the reversible Williams V Hoodie.Trousers round out the offering with laid-back elegance, including the Webster Chill jean in rope twill denim, the Tropical Wool Gibbs Pant with cargo-style pockets, and the Eli Pleated Trouser with a curtain waistband. Complementing the apparel, Kith and Salomon introduce the XT-EVO sneaker, featuring a racing-inspired upper crafted in liquid rubber and breathable mesh atop XT-6 tooling, available in two colorways.The Kith &Kin FW26 collection will be available starting August 7, 2026, at 11 a.m. local time in New York, London, Paris and Tokyo, through Kith stores, online and the Kith App. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: A Symphony of Leather and Metal: Jil Sander and Thonet’s Expanded Furniture Collection
items.text: A Symphony of Leather and Metal: Jil Sander and Thonet’s Expanded Furniture Collection Summary Jil Sander and Thonet expand the JS. THONET collection with reimagined S 411 lounge chairs and S 1070 tables.Designs merge tubular steel Bauhaus heritage with tactile luxury.Offered in SERIOUS and NORDIC lines, each engraved for authenticity. Expanding on their acclaimed inaugural partnership, Jil Sander and the historic German furniture maker Thonet have introduced the latest additions to their collaborative JS. THONET signature collection.The 2026 expansion introduces reimagined versions of the S 411 lounge chair and the S 1070 table, uniting industrial tubular steel design with warm, tactile luxury. Rooted in a shared appreciation for the Bauhaus - particularly the work of Marcel Breuer - the collection emphasizes timeless design, intuitive usability and exceptional craftsmanship. To guarantee authenticity and highlight the premium nature of the collaboration, every new piece is finished with a precisely engraved "JS. THONET" inscription on its steel frame.A standout of the new release is Jil Sander's elegant update to the S 411 lounge chair, a classic Thonet factory design originally dating back to 1932. The chair features a striking, curved S-shaped tubular steel frame that flows seamlessly into armrest coverings designed to resemble skate blades, creating a sculptural lightness that appears to float in space. Sander elevated the piece by wrapping the generously cushioned sprung upholstery entirely in leather, utilizing a specialized minimal seam and piped backing to give the chair a serene, monolithic appearance. Designed to pair effortlessly with the collaboration's B 97 nesting tables released in 2025, the seating also includes a matching S 411 H footstool for complete lounge comfort.The collection is further anchored by the S 1070 table, which reimagines a 2004 concept by Glen Oliver Löw into a minimalist, contemporary dining or conference centerpiece. Its 220 by 100 cm tabletop is distinctively divided down the middle lengthwise, offering a sense of lightness and the ability to mix or match surface colors.Both the table and the S 411 chair are offered in two distinct aesthetic lines: SERIOUS and NORDIC. The SERIOUS line utilizes a smoked glossy titanium finish for the steel frames, paired with high-gloss accents and leather in rich graphite shades like black, ruby red, green, or blue. items.title: Saturdays NYC and L.L.Bean Rework Two Heavy-Duty Totes for the Commute and the Weekend Alike
items.text: Saturdays NYC and L.L.Bean Rework Two Heavy-Duty Totes for the Commute and the Weekend Alike Summary Saturdays NYC and L.L.Bean have collaborated on a two-model tote release built for daily and weekend useThe lineup pairs the long-running Groceries Tote Tall with the Boat & Tote Large, a longstanding symbol of L.L.Bean's American craftsmanshipBoth bags fuse L.L.Bean's rugged materials and handwork with Saturdays NYC's graphics and minimal city sensibility Saturdays NYC and L.L.Bean have joined forces on a pair of tote bags that put durable, craft-driven construction under a downtown lens. The collaboration draws two silhouettes from L.L.Bean's catalog, matching the brand's tough materials and hand-finished heritage with Saturdays NYC's graphic language and pared-back urban aesthetic.The release runs across two models with different track records. The Groceries Tote Tall is a longtime staple in the range, while the Boat & Tote Large carries more history still, standing as one of the clearest emblems of the American craftsmanship L.L.Bean has built over decades. Bringing both into the collaboration gives the drop a spread between an everyday workhorse and a genuine heritage piece.The appeal of each leans on material and build. These are the kind of rugged, substantial totes L.L.Bean is known for, where the toughness of the canvas and the warmth of hand-finished construction do much of the talking. Saturdays NYC's contribution sits on top of that foundation, adding graphics and a minimal, city-minded point of view that reframes utilitarian bags as something closer to a lifestyle object.Function is the throughline. Both totes are pitched as high-capacity carriers flexible enough to move from routine daily errands around town to storage duty on weekend trips and activities. That range is the point: the same bag meant to handle a grocery run is built to hold up on a getaway, which is where the collaboration's practical case really lands.The Saturdays NYC x L.L.Bean tote collection is available now at Saturdays NYC stores and through the brand's online store. items.title: The Sold-Out FRUIT OF THE LOOM x Keiji Kaneko Jersey ATHLETIC FORMAL SUIT Is Back: Here's How To Get Yours
items.text: The Sold-Out FRUIT OF THE LOOM x Keiji Kaneko Jersey ATHLETIC FORMAL SUIT Is Back: Here's How To Get Yours Summary FRUIT OF THE LOOM and BOUTIQUE owner Keiji Kaneko have reopened pre-orders on their ATHLETIC FORMAL SUIT built entirely from heavyweight cotton jerseyThe collaboration comes in both single- and double-breasted cuts that look tailored but wear with the ease of a cardigan and sweatpantsA new brown shade joins the returning black and navy, adding a warmer seasonal option to the lineup FRUIT OF THE LOOM and BOUTIQUE proprietor Keiji Kaneko have brought back the ATHLETIC FORMAL SUIT, a collaboration that reimagines suiting in soft, heavyweight cotton jersey rather than conventional tailoring cloth. The pre-order pairs two silhouettes, a single-breasted and a double-breasted cut, with a fresh colorway expanding the range.The premise rests on the fabric. Both pieces are made from a 100% cotton heavyweight tenjiku jersey, the kind of substantial cut-and-sew material more associated with a good T-shirt than a blazer. That gives the set real body and structure while keeping the feel firmly in T-shirt territory, so a jacket that reads as tailored actually slips on like a cardigan, and trousers that pass for slacks move like sweatpants. That gap between how the suit looks and how it wears is the whole point.The two cuts split the difference between ease and polish. The single-breasted version is the lighter, more everyday option, designed to be thrown over a T-shirt or shirt for a quick lift in presentability. The double-breasted take carries a slightly dressier presence, though the jersey construction keeps it far softer than its silhouette suggests. Sizing runs M, L and XL across both.On color, the standby black and navy return and are joined by a new brown. Per the brand, black leans urban, navy reads clean, and the new brown brings a warmer, more seasonal tone suited to Fall/Winter styling. All three are pitched as flexible enough to work with sneakers, leather shoes or a cap without friction.This is a returning series that has sold through in past pre-orders, and this round is framed as another chance to choose across both cuts and the new brown. As with any pre-order of this kind, the run is finite.The FRUIT OF THE LOOM x Keiji Kaneko ATHLETIC FORMAL SUIT is available to pre-order online from August 6 through August 12, with orders closing early if allocation sells out. items.title: PORTER's New "Bounce" Series Weaves Thread in Three Directions to Build a Bag That Springs Back Into Shape
items.text: PORTER's New "Bounce" Series Weaves Thread in Three Directions to Build a Bag That Springs Back Into Shape Summary PORTER has introduced "Bounce," a new bag series built around a triaxial woven fabric that crosses thread in three directionsThe material's strength and springback are placed at high-stress points so the bags resist collapsing and stand up on their ownThe five-model lineup spans backpack, messenger and shoulder styles and marks PORTER's first new series in about 14 months PORTER has launched "Bounce," a new bag series engineered around a triaxial woven fabric that sets it apart from the label's usual construction. The textile crosses thread in three directions, vertical, horizontal and diagonal, and PORTER has built the series to draw the maximum functional benefit from that structure.The fabric is the entire story here. Triaxial weaving produces a lattice of linked regular hexagons, the same geometry that recurs throughout nature in honeycomb, tortoise shells and the retina of the human eye, and which reads as a kind of universal functional beauty. PORTER positions the material as the world's only textile realization of that hexagonal structure, made possible through advanced production technology.What matters in use is how that translates to performance. The triaxial cloth carries notable strength, springback and shape retention, and PORTER deploys it strategically rather than across the whole bag. On the backpack it sits at the front; on the tote it lines the gusset. In both cases the fabric's restoring force pulls the bag back toward its original form, so the pieces resist sagging and hold their silhouette. The payoff is bags that stand upright on their own and shrug off the misshaping that plagues softer carriers.The rest of the material choices support that engineering-led brief. The main body uses a glossy, refined nylon that keeps the look elevated rather than purely utilitarian. At the points that meet the body, the backpack's back panel and the shoulder pads on the tote and shoulder bags, PORTER switched to "Cubic Eye" piqué light, a breathable, quick-drying fabric chosen for comfort against the wearer.For those tracking the release itself, "Bounce" is a five-model series covering backpack, messenger and shoulder-bag formats, and it lands as PORTER's first new series in roughly 14 months. That gap gives the launch some weight beyond the novelty of the fabric.The PORTER "Bounce" series releases on August 7, available at select PORTER

items.title: Rockstar Games Killed 'Midnight Club 5' Because It Could Never Compete With 'GTA's' Sales Numbers
items.text: Rockstar Games Killed 'Midnight Club 5' Because It Could Never Compete With 'GTA's' Sales Numbers Summary Development on a fifth entry in the Midnight Club series included a prototype map set in London before Rockstar Games canceled the project to focus entirely on the Grand Theft Auto franchiseFormer senior designer Kris Roberts cited conflict between the Rockstar San Diego development team and the New York headquarters stemming from missed deadlines during the production of Midnight Club: Los AngelesInternal perceptions at the company treated the racing series as a secondary project that lacked the accolades and cultural weight of the studio's flagship open-world titles Rockstar Games abandoned the Midnight Club franchise following the release of its 2008 Los Angeles installment to consolidate resources around massive open-world titles like Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption. The legendary racing series was a dominant force during the earlier console generation. Fans assumed the acclaimed fourth entry would lead directly into another blockbuster release. A fifth game was actively in the works and even featured early map development for a sprawling London environment. The project ultimately collapsed under immense internal pressure.Former senior designer Kris Roberts recently revealed the turbulent final days of the franchise during an interview with Insider Gaming. Roberts explained that the cancellation stemmed from severe friction between the San Diego development team and the global headquarters in New York. The tension was largely rooted in production delays. The Los Angeles chapter was originally slated for an early 2008 launch but slipped to late October. Pushing a release date in the era before digital distribution caused massive financial strain and fractured trust with corporate leadership. Creative control battles further alienated the West Coast crew.The internal culture at the gaming giant ultimately doomed the sequel. Roberts noted that executives viewed the racing property as a "red-headed stepchild" compared to the staggering success of the main flagship titles. Data proved players were engaging with the street racing game longer than direct competitors like Need for Speed and Burnout. Executives in New York remained unimpressed because the sales numbers could never match the highest tier of the industry.
