items.title: The Pre-Owned Watch Market Is Back to Normal and Rolex Remains the Undisputed Leader
items.text: The Pre-Owned Watch Market Is Back to Normal and Rolex Remains the Undisputed Leader Summary Rolex's share of sales on Chrono24 dropped to 30.5% from a 44% peak in 2022, returning the brand to pre-pandemic market levelsThe watchmaker remains the marketplace leader with 31% of total sales volume, significantly ahead of competitors Omega and Patek PhilippeYounger shoppers are driving a shift toward dressier models like the Datejust, which has become the brand's top revenue generator on the platform The crown is heavy but Rolex still wears it. Following an unprecedented surge during the pandemic lockdown era, the secondary watch market is finally cooling off. A new report from Chrono24 reveals that Rolex currently commands 30.5 percent of sales on the platform. The figure represents a stark contrast to the 44 percent market share the Swiss powerhouse held during the peak of 2022. This shift brings the manufacturer back to its pre-pandemic baseline and indicates a broader market normalization. Prices for highly coveted timepieces are stabilizing after years of skyrocketing demand.Despite the statistical pullback, the watchmaker maintains an iron grip on the top spot. During the second quarter of this year, Rolex accounted for 31 percent of total sales volume on the marketplace. Competitors remain far behind in the rearview mirror. Omega secured 11 percent of sales volume during the same period, while Patek Philippe captured 6 percent. The changing tide is most visible in the luxury tier exceeding the $20,000 mark. In this elite bracket, brands like Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet and Vacheron Constantin are carving out larger pieces of the pie at the expense of the industry leader.Mid-tier luxury remains absolute territory for the Geneva-based giant. Timepieces priced between $10,000 and $20,000 make up the core segment where Rolex secures 61.4 percent of all Chrono24 sales. This sweet spot houses legendary silhouettes including the Submariner, the GMT-Master II and the stainless steel Daytona. Buyers chasing these iconic sports models previously fueled the massive pandemic price premiums. As hype transitions into a more calculated consumer mindset, buyers are spending their money deliberately across a wider spectrum of horological options.Younger collectors are fundamentally altering the current retail landscape. items.title: Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+ Claims Nürburgring Nordschleife Class Record
items.text: Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+ Claims Nürburgring Nordschleife Class Record Summary Mercedes-AMG has announced that the all-electric CLA 45 4MATIC+ set an official Nürburgring Nordschleife class record Driven by Kevin Berger the stock electric sedan completed the 20.8-kilometer lap in 7 minutes and 32.070 seconds Powered by three axial-flux motors producing 680 horsepower the performance EV accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.7 seconds Mercedes-AMG has officially set a new Nürburgring Nordschleife class record with the all-electric Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+. Driven by driver Kevin Berger, the high-performance four-door sedan recorded an official, notarized lap time of 7:32.070 minutes, crowning it the fastest vehicle in its segment around the iconic circuit.The record-setting run was achieved in a stock production-spec vehicle fitted with track-focused Pirelli P Zero Trofeo RS tires. Powering the electric CLA 45 is a tri-motor setup utilizing liquid-cooled axial-flux electric motors—two mounted on the rear axle and one at the front—delivering a combined output of up to 680 horsepower (500 kW). This powertrain configuration utilizes a fully variable AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel-drive system with rear torque vectoring, pushing the vehicle from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.7 seconds.Built on an 800-volt electrical architecture, the sedan integrates adaptive suspension, refined aerodynamics, and continuous thermal management engineered to sustain peak power output across demanding track laps. items.text: EVANGELION:95’s First FW26 Drop Turns Five Iconic Anime Moments Into Faux-Vintage 1995 Graphic Tees Summary EVANGELION:95 rolls out five graphic T-shirts drawn from key 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' scenes and artworkEvery tee is built on heavyweight 100% cotton with deliberate fading and distressing for a vintage feelThe lineup pulls from End of Evangelion, the fan-favorite Episode 9 battle, and a classic CD jacket EVANGELION:95 has released its first Fall/Winter 2026 run of five graphic T-shirts translating landmark Neon Genesis Evangelion imagery into apparel styled to look like it survived from 1995. Each design pairs a specific scene or piece of franchise artwork with the brand's faux-vintage construction, positioning the T-shirts as statement pieces rather than standard merch.The construction is consistent across the collection and central to its concept. Every shirt uses a 6.5oz heavyweight 100% cotton body described as smooth to the touch, durable and absorbent. From there, the brand leans into wear that would normally take years to develop, building in body fading and adding intentional distressing at the collar and cuffs. The result is a deliberately aged finish meant to sharpen each graphic, and the damage detailing is baked into the design rather than treated as a flaw.The graphics themselves span the franchise's most charged moments. Two T-shirts draw from the film End of Evangelion: the 0097 in white centers on Unit-01's awakening scene paired with "AWAKENING" text, while the 0099 in black turns to the striking Mass Production Evas, both backed by the brand's original anti-A.T. Field pattern. Another pair pulls from the fan-favorite ninth TV episode, "Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win," staging the clash between Units 01 and 02 and the Angel Israfel across front and back, each sleeve marked with an in-scene countdown time.The fifth design reaches into franchise music history. The 0103 in black is built around the CD jacket for Yoko Takahashi's single "Soul's Refrain," the theme from the film Death & Rebirth, with the vintage jacket illustration digitized in high resolution and a period poster graphic printed on the back. It lands as the most collector-leaning piece in the group.All of it flows from the brand's founding idea. items.title: Nan Shufang Carries Its Scholar's-Study Aesthetic Into Hong Kong With a Pacific Place Debut
items.text: Nan Shufang Carries Its Scholar's-Study Aesthetic Into Hong Kong With a Pacific Place Debut Summary Nan Shufang has opened its first Hong Kong store at Pacific Place, its debut location beyond the Chinese mainlandThe brand builds each space around the tradition of the Chinese scholar's study, uniting objects, setting and cultural activityWooden wares, porcelain wares, and gold and silver wares anchor a lineup meant to be used and passed down rather than simply displayed Nan Shufang, a premium Chinese cultural brand rooted in the tradition of the scholar's study, has officially opened its first Hong Kong store at Pacific Place. The opening marks a significant step in the brand's global expansion, framing the space as an immersive experience that ties together objects, setting and cultural engagement.The brand's identity reaches back to its 2008 founding. Nan Shufang established its first location in Beijing's Houhai area and takes its name from the "South Study," or Nan Shufang, of the Forbidden City, a nod to its scholarly lineage. That heritage informs a guiding belief that objects are not simply functional vessels but carriers of culture, craft and spiritual value. The brand roots that idea in a line from the Zhuangzi's "Ren Jian Shi" chapter: "The achievement of beauty takes time; the making of ugliness allows no room for correction, how cautious one must be."The Hong Kong store arrives as part of a wider footprint. Nan Shufang now runs cultural spaces across Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, a four-city network of seven stores that each interprets the scholar's-study theme through object display, spatial design and cultural experience. The mainland locations range from the founding Houhai store to metropolitan settings at Beijing's China World and SKP, a Shanghai Xintiandi space built around refined pursuits such as incense appreciation and tea tasting, a historic Amanyangyun site, and a Shenzhen Bay MixC store attuned to that city's open, contemporary character.At the center of the offering sit three craft categories. Wooden wares focus on classical furniture and scholar's-study objects built through mortise-and-tenon joinery and hand carving, with an emphasis on proportion, line and spatial rhythm. Porcelain wares carry forward classical ceramic forms and glazing, spanning everyday tea wares to desk pieces. items.title: David O. Russell's ‘Madden’ Biopic Starring Nicolas Cage To Premiere November 2026
items.text: David O. Russell's ‘Madden’ Biopic Starring Nicolas Cage To Premiere November 2026 Summary David O. Russell's John 'Madden' biopic will premiere on Prime Video in November rather than in wide releaseNicolas Cage stars as the Raiders coach turned broadcaster, with Christian Bale playing Al DavisA limited theatrical run is planned for awards eligibility, but the film skips a nationwide big-screen rollout David O. Russell's sports drama Madden, starring Nicolas Cage as the legendary football coach and commentator John Madden, is heading to Prime Video this fall. Amazon MGM, which is backing the film, has set it to arrive on the streamer November 18, with an awards-qualifying theatrical release expected earlier in the month.The film traces Madden's full arc as a defining figure in American football. He led the Oakland Raiders through repeated championship contention in the 1970s and delivered the franchise its first Super Bowl win, then retired from coaching in 1979 and spent the next three decades as a fixture of televised football as a color commentator. Russell's movie follows that career alongside two central relationships: Madden's friendship with Al Davis, played by Christian Bale, and his partnership with his wife Virginia, played by Kathryn Hahn. John Mulaney, Sienna Miller and Shane Gillis fill out the rest of the cast.Russell framed the project's ambitions when it was first announced in 2024. "[The] feature will be about the joy, humanity and genius that was John Madden in a wildly inventive, cool world of the 1970s," the director said at the time.What remains less clear is the reasoning behind the streaming-first strategy. Russell carries serious awards pedigree as the filmmaker behind American Hustle, Silver Linings Playbook and The Fighter, which makes the decision to forgo a wide theatrical release notable. That said, Russell has long been a divisive presence in Hollywood, with a well-documented history of combative on-set conduct, and his most recent feature, 2022's star-packed period piece Amsterdam, was a costly box-office failure, taking in roughly $31 million USD worldwide against an $80 million USD budget and posting heavy losses for its studio.Madden is expected to play a limited, awards-qualifying theatrical run in early November before premiering worldwide on Prime Video November 18. items.text: UNION and in･stru(mental). items.text: New Era and ‘Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn’ Stitch In-Universe Emblems Onto the 9FORTY A-Frame Trucker Summary New Era and 'Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn' team up on a 9FORTY A-Frame trucker cap through STRICT-GThe cap arrives in two versions set apart by their front emblem, one Anaheim Electronics and one Vist FoundationA single-panel pinched front, breathable mesh and an adjustable strap define the build New Era and Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn have collaborated on a 9FORTY A-Frame trucker cap, released through STRICT-G in two emblem-specific versions. Both lean on New Era's classic logo-cap format, swapping in crests tied to the anime's in-universe organizations.The foundation is New Era's 9FORTY A-Frame, a variant of the shape-retaining 9FORTY built to hold its form. Rather than a rounded multi-panel crown, the A-Frame runs a single front panel with a pinched top, giving the cap a distinctive profile before any branding is added.Function is handled through familiar trucker-cap cues. A breathable mesh construction keeps the build ventilated, while a curved visor and an adjustable strap are set up to dial in a comfortable, flexible fit.Branding is where the two versions diverge, and it stays deliberately clean. One version wears the Anaheim Electronics crest, the other the Vist Foundation crest, letting buyers pick their allegiance while keeping the rest of the design unadorned.Both versions of the STRICT-G x New Era Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn 9FORTY A-Frame trucker are scheduled to ship in September 2026 via STRICT-G. items.title: Tiny Vinyl Launches a $49.99 USD Miniature Turntable Built Specifically for Its Four-Inch Record Format
items.text: Tiny Vinyl Launches a $49.99 USD Miniature Turntable Built Specifically for Its Four-Inch Record Format Summary Compact belt-drive turntable designed specifically for four-inch 33.3 RPM recordsFeatures integrated stereo speakers, Bluetooth output and a 3.5mm headphone jackCompletes a collectible music ecosystem with matching storage crates and display frames Tiny Vinyl launched a dedicated miniature turntable engineered specifically for its proprietary four-inch record format. Priced at $49.99 USD, the new tabletop machine pairs the palm-sized discs with hardware scaled to match. The device features a black leatherette suitcase design and utilizes a belt-driven platter rotating at 33.3 RPM. While the miniature records remain fully compatible with standard manual turntables, the dedicated player provides a specialized hardware solution for casual collectors. This drop establishes a comprehensive physical ecosystem for a novelty format that has already surpassed one million global pressings.Measuring just over 10 inches wide, the unit opts for straightforward accessibility over high-end audiophile specs. The player operates via AC power and bypasses battery operation entirely. Listeners can push audio out through built-in stereo speakers or utilize Bluetooth connectivity for external sound systems. A standard 3.5mm headphone jack offers a hardwired alternative for personal listening. The machine specifically spins the brand's growing catalog of sequentially numbered releases from major artists like BTS, Rihanna, Ariana Grande and The Rolling Stones. Each pressing relies on 15 grams of 100 percent bio-attributed vinyl instead of the standard 140 grams required for a conventional LP.Beyond the core hardware, the company expanded the collectible footprint with two new organizational accessories. A $19.99 miniature storage crate features a wood frame covered in black leatherette with a velveteen interior designed to house up to 32 individual releases. Fans looking to highlight the physical artwork can grab a $14.99 square display frame equipped with a shatter-resistant window and magnetic closures. The frame holds four record jackets and mounts easily on a wall or flat surface. Together these add-ons replicate the familiar rituals of digging, shelving and exhibiting wax with considerably less furniture involved.The dedicated player transforms a novelty merchandise item into a legitimate consumer audio category. items.title: A LEGO Ideas Fan Build Recreates Jeff Koons' Iconic 'Balloon Dog' in 1,026 Bricks
items.text: A LEGO Ideas Fan Build Recreates Jeff Koons' Iconic 'Balloon Dog' in 1,026 Bricks Summary An independent designer submitted a 1,026-piece pop-art sculpture recreation to the LEGO Ideas platformThe glossy red build utilizes specialized curved windscreen elements to mimic the smooth lobes of an inflated balloonA hidden interior compartment depicts the animal as a pressurized industrial vessel operated by minifigures Contemporary art meets brick engineering with a massive new fan submission on the LEGO Ideas platform. Independent creator brxstr recently unveiled a 1,026-piece homage to the iconic Jeff Koons sculpture. While the Danish toy brand already produces a fingernail-sized balloon dog accessory for carnival sets, this display-ready model scales the concept up to 15 inches long and 12.5 inches tall.The structural foundation relies on a single specialized part. Piece 5274 is an 8x6x2 curved windscreen that entered the brand palette in 2024. The builder scrapped an earlier iteration of the project to utilize this exact element. Mirroring two of these windscreens together forms a single smooth balloon segment for the legs, body, ears and nose. Tapered tips use a smaller rounded windscreen to close off the ends. Technic angled pieces handle the internal connecting work to keep the skeleton completely hidden. A clever side effect of this construction is the visible plate seams along each lobe mimicking the natural crease lines of over-inflated latex.Beneath the serene glossy red exterior lies a highly detailed and humorous interior. Lifting the top off the body reveals a pressurized industrial operation. Inside sits a minifigure wearing a yellow hazmat suit with a radiation warning on his chest. This worker stands over a trans-blue gas cylinder equipped with a chrome pipe, a printed gauge panel and a valve wheel. Four official miniature LEGO balloon dogs sit racked up on the wall behind him like lab specimens. A second minifigure occupies the head cavity to steer the vessel.The Balloon Dog Mk II submission is currently gathering community votes to be considered for production as an official retail set. The designer noted that only two specific parts do not currently exist in the correct red colorway. He also pitched the possibility of future multicolor variants to match the diverse spectrum of the original gallery artworks. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bugatti's New One-Off Destrier Transforms the Track-Only Bolide Into a Coachbuilt Masterpiece
items.text: Bugatti's New One-Off Destrier Transforms the Track-Only Bolide Into a Coachbuilt Masterpiece Summary Bugatti’s bespoke Solitaire division has revealed the Destrier, a one-off hypercar adapting the track-focused Bolide into an elegant road-oriented machineThe vehicle retains a 1,578-horsepower quad-turbo W16 engine and carbon tub but removes aggressive downforce elements in favor of a sleek profile standing just one meter tallFinished in Sapphire Celeste blue, the model pays homage to Ralph Lauren’s Type 57SC and features a luxurious cabin detailed with leather, nubuck and 3D-knitted textiles Bugatti has expanded its exclusive Solitaire program with the unveiling of the Destrier. Built on the ferocious foundation of the Bolide track car, this unique one-of-one creation translates relentless circuit performance into a masterpiece of coachbuilt proportions. By stripping away the high-downforce prototype aerodynamics of its predecessor, the French marque highlights an incredibly low-slung carbon tub pushed forward to emphasize the brand's signature C-shaped metallic streak.The hypercar trades aggressive winglets and massive rear aero for a subtler flat spoiler and a sleek silhouette that stands just one meter tall. Flared front fenders rise sharply from the beltline, complementing staggered 20-inch front and 21-inch rear wheels. Out back, the Bolide’s quad tailpipes remain intact, though its X-shaped track lights are swapped out for a bespoke cross-shaped LED pattern. Bugatti design chief Frank Heyl noted that removing the aerodynamic constraints allowed the team to treat the underlying architecture as pure sculpture. It is scheduled to make its global debut at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.The exterior paint finish serves as a deeply rooted historical tribute. Dubbed Sapphire Celeste, the unique blue shade honors the original color of the Type 57SC Atlantic famously owned by Ralph Lauren. The aesthetic link bridges the gap between road and track, mirroring the historic relationship between the 57SC street car and the Type 57G racer that secured a victory at the 1937 24 Hours of Le Mans. The connection underscores how the new machine bridges raw motorsport heritage with refined grand touring luxury.Inside the cabin, the extreme minimalism of a race car gives way to lush materials and exquisite detailing. items.text: Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy" Merges Six Fictional Alter Egos Summary Jordan Brand is reviving its 2012 Kilroy Pack through a singular mismatched Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy"The left and right shoes feature distinct color blockings and details representing Michael Jordan's six fictional alter egosThe pair is expected to release on August 14 for $180 USD via Nike and select retailer Name: Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy"Colorway: Black/Deep Royal Blue-White-Challenge RedSKU: IV6476-010MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: August 14, 2026Where to Buy: NikeJordan Brand is revisiting a unique piece of Michael Jordan lore with the upcoming release of the Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy." The new release takes the memorable 2012 "Kilroy Pack" and creatively folds it into a single mismatched low-top silhouette.Rather than reissuing all six original pairs—dedicated to Michael Jordan's alter egos Johnny Kilroy, Motorboat Jones, Bentley Ellis, Slim Jenkins, Calvin Bailey, and Fontay Montana—the brand has scattered their signature colors and details across the design. The left shoe features a primarily black build with dark blue wrapping the lower half, an orange midsole, yellow lining, and white laces. In stark contrast, the right shoe goes in a completely different direction, utilizing red leather, black overlays, light blue lining, and black laces.To further honor the 2012 pack, the tongue tags spell out the names of the alter egos, acting as a checklist for the mismatched aesthetic. Additional thematic callbacks include three stacked Jumpman logos on the insoles and heel embroidery alternating between numbers "23" and "4." Finally, "KILROY WAS HERE" is printed behind the tongues to directly tie the model back to the original advertising campaign.The Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy" is expected to release on August 14, 2026. items.title: John David Washington to Star in Supernatural Horror Thriller 'Mime'
items.text: John David Washington to Star in Supernatural Horror Thriller 'Mime' Summary John David Washington is set to star in and produce the upcoming supernatural horror thriller 'Mime'Nikyatu Jusu will direct the film based on an original spec screenplay written by Stephen HermanSony Screen Gems acquired the feature project after competing against Amazon and Searchlight Sony's Screen Gems has officially landed the rights to Mime, an upcoming supernatural horror thriller starring John David Washington. The studio beat out competitive offers from Amazon and Searchlight to secure the feature project.Nikyatu Jusu, who made her feature directorial debut with the Sundance Grand Jury Prize winner Nanny, is attached to direct. The screenplay was written by Stephen Herman based on his original spec concept, though specific storyline details are currently being kept under wraps.The project is produced by Matt Tolmach alongside The Black Phone filmmaker Scott Derrickson via his Crooked Highway banner. Washington will also serve as a producer on the film alongside Tolmach's partner Camila Grove. Washington previously starred in Spike Lee's BlacKkKlansman, Christopher Nolan's Tenet, Gareth Edwards' The Creator, and most recently appeared in the 2024 drama The Piano Lesson. One of two neuroscience-backed models alongside the Mind 002 sneaker, the mule has sold out with regularity since it launched in January, giving this new colorway a built-in audience.On the makeup itself, official images show Palest Purple running from heel to toe, keeping the design almost entirely tonal. Early Mind releases leaned on a bright accent applied to the 22 foam nodes underfoot, but Nike has since moved away from that approach, leaning into fully monochrome executions across its more recent drops. The "Palest Purple" sits squarely in that newer, tonal direction. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The café serves original blends and Cabourn’s beloved flat white, extending the brand’s lifestyle ethos into a sensory experience.To commemorate the opening, customers spending over ¥22,000 JPY (approx. $150 USD) will receive an exclusive Omotesando Store keychain, designed in homage to vintage motel chains and engraved with messages such as “Cheers body!” and “Love Nige x.”Nigel Cabourn OMOTESANDO STOREPine Under Flat B1F, 5-13-2 JingumaeShibuya-ku, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The Tokyo Jazz Club is set to make its debut in November, launching as a major new cultural event in partnership with Art Week Tokyo. Located near the Jimbocho district, the innovative project will take over all eight floors of a former capsule hotel, transforming the unconventional venue into a dynamic, multi-level hybrid space.Designed to blur the boundaries between a contemporary art exhibition, a socialization hub and a marketplace, the Tokyo Jazz Club will bring together a diverse array of artists, galleries, and musicians under one roof. items.title: Timberland's FW26 Tokyo Design Collective Line Reinterprets "Timeless Heritage" Through Flannel, Corduroy and Leather
items.text: Timberland's FW26 Tokyo Design Collective Line Reinterprets "Timeless Heritage" Through Flannel, Corduroy and Leather Summary The Timberland by TOKYO DESIGN COLLECTIVE line returns for its seventh installment with a Fall/Winter 2026 collectionA "TIMELESS HERITAGE" theme centers on Timberland's material heritage and enduring brand colorsTokyo-directed design filters American workwear roots through Japanese craftsmanship and sensibility Timberland is releasing the seventh installment of Timberland by TOKYO DESIGN COLLECTIVE, the premium line directed by the Tokyo-based TDC team, with a Fall/Winter 2026 collection built around a "TIMELESS HERITAGE" theme. The season leans on the brand's long-standing material use and timeless colors, translated through a distinctly Japanese lens.The collection is drawn from Timberland's roots in American workwear and outdoor culture, then rebuilt with Japanese craftsmanship and feel. Framed as a Japan-born project that speaks to a global audience, it aims for pieces that balance approachability, functionality and a universality meant to outlast trends.Fabric is where that thinking gets concrete. The season's key materials are a yarn-dyed flannel with rich surface character, a corduroy defined by its refined wale, and the premium leather that has long been a Timberland signature. By combining those different materials deliberately, TDC pushes the designs toward a space where classic and modern elements sit together rather than competing. The lineup runs all-gender, spanning outerwear such as the Stratham bomber and a heavier zip jacket, an LS thermal, a TIMBS hoodie, and headwear including a waxed leather-patch cap and a corded hat.The reinterpretation extends to how the collection is shown. TDC places its Tokyo-made styles within architecture and scenery that read as unmistakably Japanese, capturing the product among contrasting forces of nature and city, stillness and motion. It is a framing meant to express the team's particular view: heritage seen again through a Japanese sensibility.That heritage runs deep on the Timberland side. The brand was founded in 1973 in Stratham, New Hampshire, and earned global recognition with the original Yellow Boot, designed for people working in the harsh conditions of New England. items.title: Lionsgate Targets a Late 2027 to Early 2028 Release for ‘Michael 2’
items.text: Lionsgate Targets a Late 2027 to Early 2028 Release for ‘Michael 2’ Lionsgate is pushing ahead on Michael 2, the sequel to its blockbuster Michael Jackson biopic, with plans to roll cameras as early as late 2026 or the start of 2027. Motion picture chief Adam Fogelson laid out the timeline on the studio's latest earnings call, flagging a release window that runs from the end of 2027 into the first half of 2028.The sequel's momentum is a direct product of the original's numbers. Michael, directed by Antoine Fuqua, became a commercial powerhouse, grossing in the neighborhood of $1 billion USD worldwide and posting what has been billed as the strongest opening a biopic has ever recorded. The film charts the King of Pop's climb from the Jackson 5 to global superstardom and closes on his 1987 Bad tour, with the singer's real-life nephew Jaafar Jackson in the lead. Its parting title card, "His Story Continues," left little doubt that a follow-up was coming.On the timeline itself, Fogelson signaled that the sequel can lean partly on footage already in the can. A number of sequences filmed for the first movie went unused and are now likely to migrate into the second. "We have a number of sequences, particularly some big musical sequences, that were shot previously, that are almost sure to be incorporated," Fogelson said on the earnings call. He added that the studio's attention is currently on delivering the biggest, best sequel it can at the right price.Stay tuned for more details. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The upcoming colorway introduces a thermal heat map treatment paired with bold structural overlays.The upper is constructed with a deep purple base overlaid with a bleeding gradient of red, yellow, aqua, and blue hues that simulate a radar scan. Bright orange covers the oversized Swoosh logo alongside sharp, angular support pieces embedded through the midsole. Black accents settle across the tongue, laces with orange trim, collar, and outsole, giving the multi-toned color arrangement a grounded frame.Shifting away from the softer contours of the Ja 3, the Ja 4 features a more angular build with heavily textured materials and enlarged support structures surrounding the midfoot and heel. Personal details for the guard appear throughout, including Morant's signature logo on the tongue and repeated "12" markings molded into the orange sections underfoot.The Nike Ja 4 "Radar" releases in October 2026 for $140 USD. items.text: Nike Wraps the Mind 002 Slip-On in Cooling “Work Blue” Nike has revealed a "Work Blue" colorway of the Mind 002, dressing its neuroscience-minded slip-on in a cooler palette for Fall/Winter. The makeover reworks the model's established look rather than reshaping the shoe itself, pairing a blue-forward upper with a bright accent.The colorway sticks to the blueprint the Mind 002 debuted with. Its two-tone blocking carries over, but this run fills that structure with cooler shades across the upper, giving the slip-on a calmer, more subdued read. The lead tone is a Horizon Blue that sets the mood for the whole makeup.Against those cool shades, the shoe reworks its high-visibility detailing through a Light Lemon Twist trim. It functions as the makeup's one jolt of contrast, a fresh take on the hi-vis accenting that keeps the pair from reading as entirely monochromatic.Underpinning the colorway is the Mind line itself, Nike's slip-on platform positioned around its neuroscience angle.The 002 sits as the more attainable, everyday-ready entry point into that family, a lower-key counterpart to the sold-out, resale-inflated Mind 001. items.title: Ye Unveils Four Pastel Colorways for the Upcoming Yeezy 800
items.text: Ye Unveils Four Pastel Colorways for the Upcoming Yeezy 800 Summary Ye has revealed four new pastel colorways of the independent Yeezy 800 silhouetteThe retro running design combines ballistic mesh nubuck overlays and textured synthetic panelsThe model is expected to release during Fall/Winter 2026 via Yeezy YEEZY founder Ye has revealed new pastel iterations of the upcoming YEEZY 800 silhouette. The updated previe, which the artist posted to his Instagram Stories, expands upon the initial all-black edition of the independent runner, introducing a vibrant shift from the brand's traditional muted earth tones.The Yeezy 800 leans into a retro running shape, featuring a complex layered construction across the upper. Ballistic mesh forms the tongue, while textured panels reinforce the toe and heel sections. Nubuck-like overlays frame the eyestays and forefoot, complemented by layers of loose, gauze-style mesh that give the upper a raw, unpolished texture that continues onto portions of the midsole.Marking a return to the numbered naming format used throughout Ye's classic releases, the model signals a new era of independent production for the brand. Following reports of a retail partnership with JD Sports, the silhouette could become one of the first post-adidas Yeezy footwear releases to receive wider mainstream distribution.The Yeezy 800 is expected to launch during Fall/Winter 2026 through the Yeezy website and select retailers. items.title: teamLab Transforms Osaka's Sunflowers Into an Interactive Ecosystem
items.text: teamLab Transforms Osaka's Sunflowers Into an Interactive Ecosystem Summary teamLab unveils new interactive sunflower artwork at Osaka Botanical Garden.Sunflowers glow and emit tones, responding to visitor presence and movement.Installation fosters connection, awareness and meditative engagement with nature through digital art. International art collective teamLab has unveiled its latest seasonal interactive installation, Life is the Small Sun Flickering in the Dark, at the permanent nighttime open-air museum teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka inside Nagai Park. Featuring a soundscape created by composer Hideaki Takahashi, the 2026 installation transforms a field of roughly 20,000 white sunflowers into an ethereal, glowing landscape where living flora, technology, and human presence merge into a single interactive ecosystem. Operating on view through August 16, 2026 - subject to the seasonal blooming period of the flowers - the exhibition turns the botanical garden into a dynamic sensory environment after dusk.The artwork comes to life through human and animal interaction across the darkness. When visitors or local wildlife approach and stand near the sunflowers, the individual plants respond by illuminating more intensely and emitting a distinct resonant audio tone. This initial pulse of light and sound rapidly ripples outward to adjacent sunflowers, creating a continuous wave that radiates through the entire field. If a secondary wave of light approaches from across the meadow, it alerts guests to the presence of another person or creature moving on the far side, transforming the physical behaviors of those in the space into a collective visual and auditory dialogue.Rooted in teamLab’s conceptual exploration of how existence is continuous with its surrounding environment, Life is the Small Sun Flickering in the Dark frames each sunflower not as an isolated entity, but as part of an interconnected web of relationships. Rather than treating art as a static object with rigid physical boundaries, the collective uses flow, light, and sound to establish an evolving ecological field where audience participation actively shapes the structure of the pieceteamLab Botanical Garden OsakaNagai Botanical Garden at 1-23 Nagaikoen,Higashisumiyoshi-ku, Osaka 546-0034, Japan View this post on Instagram A post shared by teamLab (@teamlab) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Seiko Brings Its ‘Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches’ Exhibition to London This Summer
items.text: Seiko Brings Its ‘Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches’ Exhibition to London This Summer Seiko will bring its Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches exhibition to Japan House in London. This marks the third consecutive year the brand has showcased its Power Design Project outside Japan, offering visitors a rare glimpse into the creative process behind one of the world’s most respected watchmakers. The exhibition highlights Seiko’s philosophy of innovation and craftsmanship, while celebrating Japanese culture in a global setting.The exhibition highlights seven conceptual timepieces, each expressing a different designer's hyper-fixation on specific physical elements. Takuya Matsumoto’s "Dial Texture" uses high-precision metal stamping - controlled to within one-hundredth of a millimeter - to render intricate geometric patterns inspired by Spain's Alhambra Palace.Naoya Sukeda’s "Machining Marks" draws inspiration from fine woodworking, deliberately leaving visible tool marks and file textures on a stepped steel case to celebrate the artisan's hand. Meanwhile, Design Director Miho Wada’s "Bar Indices" transforms standard hour markers into a hypnotic grid across a rectangular face, creating a dense mosaic where polished beams harmonize light.Rounding out the lineup are concepts that redefine watch geometry and typography. Yu Ishihara’s "Spherical Surface" seamlessly aligns the curvature of the glass, bezel, case and crown guard into a single continuous sphere. Free to the public, the exhibition will officially unveil at Japan House on August 27 and will remain on view until September 15, 2026.Japan House101-111 Kensington High St,London W8 5SA, United Kingdom Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: KIDILL x UMBRO's "Wizard" FW26 Track Suit Pairs a Waist-Length Hood With 40-Plus Adjusters
items.text: KIDILL x UMBRO's "Wizard" FW26 Track Suit Pairs a Waist-Length Hood With 40-Plus Adjusters Summary KIDILL and UMBRO have reunited for a second collaboration, delivering a unisex "Wizard" track jacket and matching track pantsThe set builds on UMBRO's functional sportswear patterns while carrying KIDILL's punk sensibility and the sorcery-tinged theme of its Fall/Winter 2026 "Heaven" collectionMore than 40 adjusters let the wearer reshape the garments, and the jacket's hood extends dramatically down to the waist KIDILL and UMBRO have linked for a second time, folding a unisex "Wizard" track jacket and track pants into KIDILL's Fall/Winter 2026 "Heaven" collection. The pairing runs UMBRO's athletic construction through KIDILL's subversive lens, arriving as a track set that treats its own silhouette as something the wearer can rebuild at will.The engineering is the hook. Both the jacket and the pants are fitted with more than 40 adjusters positioned along their seams and panel breaks, and cinching or releasing them lets the wearer stretch and reshape the outline of each piece. It is a genuinely modular approach to a track suit, one that keeps the functional bones of sportswear intact while opening the garment up to constant reinvention.That performance framework comes from UMBRO, whose sportswear patterning forms the base of the collaboration. KIDILL then layers its own punk attitude on top, and the clearest expression of that is the jacket's hood, which extends far enough to reach the waist. The exaggerated shape reads like something pulled from a sorcerer's robe, a deliberate nod that ties the piece to the wider mood of the season.That mood is where the collaboration connects to a bigger story. The set belongs to KIDILL's "Heaven" collection, whose Fall/Winter 2026 lineup runs on tarot-inspired artwork, and the wizardly hood is designed to echo that visual world. The result positions a functional two-piece as part of a larger narrative rather than a standalone drop. Offered across four colorways in black, pink, blue, and gray, the range extends the partnership the two brands first explored together in the Spring/Summer 2025 season.The KIDILL x UMBRO "Wizard" track jacket and track pants release on Saturday, August 8, 2026, at KIDILL ROOM and KIDILL stockists. items.text: Alysa Liu Fronts Nike Studio Fleece Campaign & Rains Steps Into Footwear in This Week's Top Fashion News SummaryNigel Cabourn and Andersson Bell opened distinct new flagship boutiques in Japan.Christie’s is auctioning off The Devil Wears Prada 2 wardrobe; the V&A highlighted Burberry’s trench history.RAINS launched its first waterproof boots, while Olympian Alysa Liu fronted Nike's latest fleece campaign.What Alysa Liu Wears When She's Not on the IceFresh off securing a historic gold medal at the Milan Winter Olympics, figure skating champion Alysa Liu stepped out of the rink to front Nike's vibrant Studio Fleece campaign. Known for injecting Gen-Z energy and alt aesthetics into her sport, Liu showcased her off-duty style in a surrealist pastel salon setting. In an exclusive interview for Hypebeast, the 20-year-old athlete explained how growing up in Oakland, California, shaped her eclectic, deeply personal approach to fashion. Further, Liu shared that she prioritizes both "mobility" and "comfort," highlighting her love for layering baggy sweatpants and oversized hoodies with sneakers. Read the full interview now at the link above, where Liu discusses and breaks down her off-duty wardrobe, recovery rituals, and life beyond the rink.RAINS Steps Into Footwear With Debut Waterproof Boots CollectionRAINS officially stepped into the footwear arena and launched its first-ever waterproof boot collection. The Scandinavian brand expanded its global rainwear legacy by introducing two primary silhouettes: the Dry Boot and the Mirage. The functional models, which footwear architect Martin Sallières helped bring to life, ranged from classic Chelsea cuts to exaggerated clog styles. The collection boasted responsive cushioning and unique grid-patterned outsoles that drew inspiration from New York City's block layout. Ultimately, the weather-ready footwear release translates the brand's signature sculptural minimalism into all-day, all-climate wearability. As unpredictable weather becomes a greater consideration for consumers, rain-geared footwear may see an uptick in the coming seasons.Christie's New York to Auction Costumes From 'The Devil Wears Prada 2'In a crossover between cinema and high fashion, Christie's and 20th Century Studios announced an exclusive online auction that featured the original wardrobe from The Devil Wears Prada 2. items.title: mfpen's 10th Anniversary Runway Show Teases New Balance Collaboration
items.text: mfpen's 10th Anniversary Runway Show Teases New Balance Collaboration On Wednesday, mfpen presented its SS27 collection “Deadlines” at Copenhagen Fashion Week. Marking 10 years in business, the Danish label embraces the spirit of imperfection for a collection of “overworked” office-wear-inspired silhouettes.Exploring “the feeling of working late nights on a project to meet a deadline,” the SS27 collection translates this theme into the garments through lightly distressed fabrics and slouchy styling. For more interesting proportions, wool shorts and skirts cut too short expose inner lining, while the sleeves of tops, including a cable-knit sweater, extend past the hands. Together, these design choices break from the formality of the workplace, placing a primacy on unkempt and lived-in detailing.In one men’s look, a red floral jacquard shirt is worn with the chest exposed and paired with a dark gray suit, while another utilizes a white checked shirt with a loosely styled floral necktie and front-pleated trousers. Other men’s looks get subtle feminine touches from lace stockings and tassel trims, while sun-faded jersey knits and raw-cut hems add a gritty sensibility to the collection.Accessories like glossy leather messenger bags and belts with chrome grommets bring an alternative character to the range, balancing out the more formal silhouettes. Finally, for footwear, mfpen introduces a New Balance Made in USA 992 that follows the neutral late 90s feel of the accompanying garments.See the gallery above for a full look at mfpen SS27 at Copenhagen Fashion Week. items.title: BEAMS Opens Doors to Inaugural Malibu Outpost
items.text: BEAMS Opens Doors to Inaugural Malibu Outpost Japanese menswear label BEAMS has expanded its U.S. presence by officially opening BEAMS MALIBU on the California coast.Located at 23710 Malibu Road, the seaside store operates on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.BEAMS MALIBU has opened its doors officially opened its doors nestled right next to California’s southern coast. The opening is only the latest development in the ubiquitous Japanese menswear label’s expansion into the US, which has largely taken place in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.Starting today, shoppers can browse and buy BEAMS at a seaside Malibu Rd space that will be open only on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from 11 AM to 6 PM. The Japanese label quietly announced the move earlier this year, saying, “BEAMS has secured a location in Malibu, California and is currently preparing for the upcoming project,” on BEAMS America’s official site. It comes after the brand’s first-ever BEAMS Plus Limited Store in central LA in 2024 and the later “All Things Japan” pop-up in Summer 2025. View this post on InstagramA post shared by BEAMS America (@beams_america) The brand’s long-awaited entrance into the US market was confirmed in 2025 with the official e-commerce launch of BEAMS America. Since then, the brand’s American arm has released a plethora of dedicated collabs with labels like Vans and Champion. BEAMS expands its presence at a time when Japanese fashion gains popularity stateside via retailers like UNIQLO and MUJI, as well as trends like Japanese selvedge denim and sashiko stitching. As the nation's cross-cultural influence continues to grow in the West, BEAMS’ recent moves suggest there may be more stores coming in the near future.BEAMS MALIBU23710 Malibu Road, Malibu, CA 90265Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00 am – 6:00 pm Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: This 1:1 ‘Fallout’ Pip-Boy Comes Off Your Wrist and Onto Your Desk
items.text: This 1:1 ‘Fallout’ Pip-Boy Comes Off Your Wrist and Onto Your Desk Summary The Wand Company has produced an officially licensed Pip-Boy replica tied to the Amazon Original Fallout seriesBuilt as a 1:1 wearable, it pairs die-cast metal and a hand-weathered finish with a functioning LCD screenA machined metal stand lets the piece double as an in-universe desk clock when it is not being worn The Wand Company has recreated the Fallout Pip-Boy as a fully functional, wearable 1:1 replica, officially licensed by Amazon Studios from its live-action series. Modeled on the show's prop geometry, the collectible reproduces the Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V as a piece that works as both cosplay hardware and a desktop display.Construction is where the replica makes its case. The front casing is die-cast metal finished with hand-applied weathering, so each unit carries its own worn-in character, while the body is built from engineered injection-moulded ABS. A memory foam cuff lines the interior for universal fitting and longer wear, striking a balance between authentic materials and something you can actually strap on. The piece is described as the most accurate reproduction of the wrist-worn "Personal Information Processor" yet made, an ambition that tracks with The Wand Company's reputation for high-fidelity prop replicas.The electronics carry the fantasy further. A TFT LCD screen runs more than 45 different in-universe screens and animations pulled directly from the series, navigated through a side control dial, and the same display doubles as a working timepiece with an in-universe alarm. A built-in FM radio lets owners tune real stations or switch over to Wasteland broadcasts at the press of a button. Power comes from a rechargeable Li-Po cell topped up over USB-C, which also allows the replica to run constantly on for an always-lit desk display.That desk life is anchored by the stand. The replica ships with a solid, machined metal stand that seats it cleanly and unlocks the table-clock function, turning a cosplay prop into an everyday object. The result speaks to how far the Pip-Boy has traveled, from an in-game HUD to a live-action prop to a piece of hardware sitting on a collector's shelf.The officially licensed Fallout Pip-Boy replica is available via Amazon.
